NAME: Rex
TEXT: Rexie Rex is a beautiful confident boy, he is fun and loves to play and splash in water but he's also gentle as a lamb. He has grown up on the farm all his life and is enjoying the new routines of his retirement, loving attention when he plays and also leaning on you for affection, more pats please! He's also an excellent walker on the lead. Rex has a lovely nature and gets along with people, kids 10+, birds and other breeds of dogs big or small. He would make a beautiful, loving pet for most households and would keep you amused with his antics and joy for life then snuggles when it's time to rest. 💌

NAME: Julie
TEXT: Miss Julie is a playful, confident girl who loves her toys, a run around with the other dogs (retired greyhounds and Jug), a splash in her clam shell pool and just being around people and kids 7+, too. She's a bit of a character, loves to show off but she's not over the top, just a happy girl! At 6 she hasn't lost energy but slows down faster and rests longer, especially as she is learning the comforts of retired life! Julie has grown up on the farm and has come into town life ready for her new home. She has taken to a nice cosy bed on the floor and loves being on the patio as well on the warm nights. She would suit someone, a couple or family with the time to get to know her, take her for a walk and have a bit of playtime with her in the morning, especially if you are going off to work. Some toys, an outdoor bed, pool, sandpit or another dog friend will keep her company for the day, plus plenty of rests. She's easy going and not worried by pet birds or little fluffy dogs. Just a sweetheart ready to relish retired life. 💗

NAME: Debra
TEXT: Meet Debra, the hilarious and playful girl who will keep you smiling all day long! Debra loves to bounce around and show off her excitable personality, often offering a fun play bow! She is highly people social and always eager to be near her humans, and enjoy snuggling right up to you when on the couch. Debra's also a big fan of meeting new people - she’ll be the first to trot up to strangers for some pats! Thanks to her strong food drive, Debra is an absolute dream when it comes to training. She has excellent name recall, responds well to commands like "on your bed" "off" "down" and "shake". When it comes to walks, Debra is a pro on the lead and this adventurous girl would do well in a quieter dog populated neighbourhood to make her walks breezy and enjoyable! Debra would thrive in a home with kids who have experience with bigger dogs and can appreciate her bouncy nature. She could also adapt well to a household with full-time workers and is apartment-friendly - Making her a great fit to many kinds of homes! Debra has shown to get along well with other medium to large dogs, meaning she could be a great fit for a family looking to add to their furry companions. This adorable and well rounded girl is available now at our Western Sydney location!

NAME: Dora
TEXT: Pleased to introduce you to the wonderful Dora! Dora is a senior lady looking to share her love with a new family. Dora has spent time living with a young family for approx 12 months & is now ready to find her forever home. She loves young children. Very patient & calm with them. Dora is gentle, kind & affectionate. Engaging in sweet cuddles & kisses. Dora may adapt to living on her own or in an apartment. Confident & content, she might well adapt to full-time workers as well :)

NAME: Joy
TEXT: Fill your home with Joy! Sweet and little girl Joy is a very lovely girl! She is polite with the other dogs she has met and could be suited to living with another large breed dog. She is calm in the yard and has shown the ability to settle for short hours, possibly being able to build to longer hours. A home with older and respectful children could be suitable for Joy. A bundle of joy, apply to adopt this darling girl today!

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Looking for a sweetheart that loves children, engaging in fun play & snuggling? Then Millie is the girl for you! Millie is very excitable & playful! Loves to run around being a little silly & cheeky. Quick to jump in a body of water.... even on picture day hehe :)

NAME: Timmy
TEXT: Timmy is the life of the party! and a self-proclaimed ladies' man! He loves attention & affection. Loves to run around, playing & being a bit of a goof! Timmy would love to find a family who will play, throw, catch & then snuggle in for some TLC! He is a confident & curious fellow who will join the family on adventures to make those memories even more special :)

NAME: Pockets
TEXT: Pockets is a stunning 2-year-old white and brindle girl who has been a beloved pet her entire life. She’s easy to handle, does everything right, and has a calm, well-mannered nature. Having grown up on a farm and around children from a young age, Pockets is fantastic with kids and adapts well to different environments. She’s quiet—never a barker—and walks beautifully on the lead. She’s also small-dog and cat workable with the right time and training. Whether you’re looking for a loving family pet or a loyal companion, Pockets is the perfect match! Ready to meet Pockets? Contact us today!

NAME: Venus
TEXT: Meet Venus – The Perfect Family Companion! Venus is a beautiful 6-year-old fawn girl with a loving and playful nature. She enjoys her daily walks and a fun play in the backyard but is just as happy relaxing indoors. Having lived inside for the past three months, Venus is well-adjusted to home life. She has grown up around children as young as two, making her a great fit for a family home. She walks well on the lead and is both apartment-friendly and suitable for full-time workers. If you’re looking for a gentle and adaptable companion, Venus is ready to steal your heart! Contact us today to meet Venus!

NAME: Jamillie
TEXT: Meet Jamillie – A Loving and Confident Companion! Jamillie is a sweet and affectionate small female, weighing just 22kg. As the sister of Blaze and Poppy, she shares the same wonderful temperament—gentle, loving, and full of confidence. She is fully crate trained and inside trained, making her a well-mannered addition to any home. Jamillie is great with kids and is small-dog workable, meaning she can adapt well with proper introductions. If you’re looking for a loyal and affectionate companion, Jamillie could be the perfect match for you! Interested in meeting Jamillie? Get in touch today!

NAME: Kelly
TEXT: Meet Kelly – Your Perfect Calm Companion! Kelly is a gentle and affectionate 7-year-old girl looking for a loving forever home. She’s crate trained, fully house and toilet trained, and loves nothing more than snoozing the day away. This sweet-natured girl has been around smaller dogs and is great with kids. She walks beautifully on the lead and would suit an apartment or a quieter home, making her the perfect match for an older person looking for a loyal companion. If you’re looking for a calm, well-mannered, and loving companion, Kelly is the one for you! Ready to meet Kelly? Contact us today!

NAME: Zali
TEXT: Zali is a super sweet, super soft & kind little lady. Zali is a very small female greyhound who would love to find the perfect family. She will benefit from a quieter home, perhaps with another canine pal. She has grown up around young teenage children who adore her. Zali can be a little shy at first but with encouragement, will bring you a toy to play with :)

NAME: Joy
TEXT: Let us introduce JOY! and what a Joy she is! Joy brings out the best in us all. She is full of happiness, kindness & love. Joy is a senior lady but in no way does that slow her down. She is confident, engaging & playful. She loves to explore & is eager to learn. Joy has grown up with smaller breeds of dogs, chickens, ducks & sheep around. If you're searching for two lovely ladies to join your family, Joy's sister Boss, is also available :)

NAME: Boss
TEXT: Miss Boss! Isn't she just a beautiful girl! So happy, care-free & loving. She is affectionate, engaging & patient. Waiting with those big, gorgeous eyes for many many cuddles & kisses. She is an older lady but has a heart full of youth & passion. She will thrive in her new home. Boss has exposure to many different animals, various small breeds, chickens, ducks and sheep. If you're looking for two lovelies to join your home, Boss's sister Joy, is also available :)

NAME: Juno
TEXT: Sweet Juno! Juno is prettiest little lady who is searching for her perfect home. She is so soft, sweet & kind in nature. Juno would love to find a home with the support & time she so deserves to grow and conquer. Juno would benefit from having another friend around to show her the ropes or live with someone who works part-time to allow for maximum bonding and growth.

NAME: Vixen
TEXT: Meet Vixen, a spunky and joyful girl who’s ready to find her forever home! With her excitable energy and sweet cuddly nature, Vixen is the type of dog who’ll brighten anyone's day! While she’s got a ton of enthusiasm and excitement to share with her people, she’d be happiest as your one and only pup — so she can enjoy having all the attention to herself! Given the time and patience to adjust to her new routine, Vixen will quickly learn how to be the best companion and show you what an amazing pet she can be! If you’re looking for a loving & gentle girl with lots of personality and a zest for life, Vixen just might be your perfect match.

NAME: Basil
TEXT: Say hello to Basil! The spice you didn’t even know you were missing from your life. He's confident & social and loves affection. Basil is a people pleaser who loves nothing more than a pat and lots of treats. He walks gently on the lead, showing off his wonderful manners for all to see. He would love to live with or without another greyhound pal, as long as he's got some adoring fans to shower him with affection! Basil has been known for carrying around his toys. We feel Basil would suit a home with respectful kids, making him the perfect herb addition to your veggie patch! Basil is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Banks
TEXT: This friendly boy loves his toys and loves spending time with other dogs (and is also learning that small dogs are friends!) Banks could suit a home with a courtyard/townhouse and kids who enjoy fun, adventures and playtime! Banks is a brand new face here at the centre so watch this space for more updates! Banks is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Sandy (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Weighing in at just 25 kg this teeny tiny girl makes up for her size with her adorable personality! Sweet, happy, confident little girl Sandy would be happy with many home types. She is a confident lady who walks super nicely on the lead. She likes treats and will definitely persuade you with her puppy dog eyes. She has spent time living with other greyhounds before and would suit a multi-dog household. Playful and loving, she absolutely loves people and has never met someone she didn't like - making her suitable for a busy social life or a family with kids. She is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Dawn
TEXT: Rise and shine! Time to greet the day and welcome a stunning new Dawn! Dawn has risen onto the adoption scene - this sweet and calm girl has a burst of play time and then will stand gently by your side for pats. This little lady would enjoy a nice courtyard/backyard to zoom and lounge around in during the day. She is energetic at times, and would do best with outdoor access, as when she is not snoozing through the day she loves to explore and run around. We think she would also be fine in a home with kids who would enjoy her affectionate and playful side. She loves to be scratched behind the ears and rubbed on the belly. Dawn will gladly be petted by humans whether they are strangers or not. Dawn can either be on her own with full/part time workers or with a canine friend as she seems to get along well with other dogs she has met with us - including small dogs. She is not reactive to other dogs and walks well around noisy streets. Apply online now to take Dawn home - she is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Gordie
TEXT: Outgoing yet chill boy Gordie has experience with kids, small/big dogs and travels well, making him a great addition for a growing family or a family looking for a handsome young lad to join them on adventures. He would love to live in a unit apartment & he can even do stairs! Gordie likes the chill life too, and enjoys settling in our office under the A/C. He's the perfect blend of playful, affectionate and chill - the ideal greyhound if we do say so ourselves. Gordie is still learning his tricks at the adoption centre so watch this space for more updates! He is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Crumpet
TEXT: Hi everyone, I’m as sweet as a honey drizzled crumpet, and ready to accompany you through your your future brunches and breakfasts. I think I’ll definitely be the sweetest part of your day. I like to be patted and get cuddles but can initially be a bit shy, so a family with respectful kids would be the home I’d be happiest in. I’m gentle, affectionate, cuddly, and kind to everyone I meet. I have been a polite lady with other greyhound friends & small dogs in our backyard at the centre. I am also learning what these so called "cats" are - stay tuned for updates! I could work up to longer hours alone as I settle well inside. I really enjoy being indoors, so where ever you live - an apartment or house, that's no problem with me. Full time hours with a dog pal would also suit me just fine! No wonder I'm named after something so sweet, huh! I’m available to adopt from our Western Sydney adoption centre, apply below to meet me!

NAME: Conrad
TEXT: **Conrad is currently in a foster home - reach out to the team to meet him!** Conrad is a quiet natured, reserved yet affectionate boy. He is polite meeting other big or small dogs when out and about but would suit a home willing to take things slow while he learns about the world around him. He could happily co exist with another doggie with a similar gentle temperament. He can be a nervous hound when he’s in a new environment and would suit a home with children who are quiet and respectful as he learns to gain his confidence. Conrad is enjoying foster care and can't wait to show you all his new pet skills! Conrad is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre. **Conrad is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Andy
TEXT: Andy is a stunning boy who wont run up and jump on everyone. He will read the room and get to know you since he is a laid back and reserved in nature. He has been around young children, little dogs and has had frequent visits from native animals while living on the south coast.

NAME: Friday
TEXT: Thank God It's Friday! Friday is super affectionate, cat/dog suitable, loves food & cuddles. Friday has a bright and bubbly personality which we all adore here at the centre. Friday shows nice calm behaviours with a mix of playful and silly, making him a perfect addition to many home types. Friday would enjoy a home with a courtyard/backyard style, as he enjoys the indoor/outdoor lifestyle, sunbaking with a mix of couch naps. Respectful children would enjoy his gentle yet fun energy. This versatile and confident boy is sure to tick the boxes. Come and meet Friday at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Woody
TEXT: Do you have a doggie squad looking to add a placid & affectionate senior to the mix? My foster carers call me smoochy, cuddly, quirky, smart & obedient. I love people, I'm so excited for everyone to pat me! My foster carers tell me I'm a special "blue fawn" colour which is apparently quite rare! My foster family go away for full time work & I'm totally blasé about it with my 2 doggie pals next to me. I'm a lazy bones but happy for a daily stroll where I promise to walk perfectly on the lead. I'm ready to share my multi-dog home life experience, tried and tested pet skills & affectionate nature with you! Come meet Woody today and discover the love that only a senior greyhound can offer. **Woody is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info** *Woody has spent months in foster care with 2 greyhound buddies, one male one female - contact the Western Sydney team to meet him*

NAME: Chicken
TEXT: Chicken is the perfect indoor companion – she settles beautifully and is happy to relax while her humans are at work full-time. Chicken gets along well with other dogs, big or small, as long as they’re calm and friendly – just like her! When you’re home, she’ll shower you with love and even paw at you for extra cuddles! Respectful children would love her affectionate nature. She’s a dream on the leash, walking calmly by your side, and her love for treats makes her a joy to train. If you’re looking for a loving, low-maintenance companion who adores snuggles, Chicken is the one for you! This little chicken is ready to find her forever family! Contact Western Sydney to meet her!

NAME: Azzie
TEXT: Great with young children. Happy go lucky guy. Calm, friendly & sweet natured. Good with smaller breeds of dogs. A quieter lifestyle would be best. If you might consider welcoming two greyhounds into your home, Azi’s brother Arrie is also searching for his forever home :)

NAME: Arthur
TEXT: Relaxed & easy going guy. Very easy on lead. This gentle guy has grown up around young children. Gets on well with large breeds of dogs. A quieter lifestyle preferred, however, I do love my fluffy toys to play around with.

NAME: Xena
TEXT: Confident, sweet & all round loving lady. Very affectionate & kind natured. Has grown up around young children. Calm & patient, yet also cheeky & playful. With the correct intro, Xena could become great friends with your cat & smaller fluffy pets. Xena holds herself with confidence, she could adapt well to indoor living.

NAME: Martha
TEXT: Loves to play & engage in play with fluffy toys. Confident in new spaces. Would prefer a home with part-time workers or another medium/large canine friend live with. Has grown up around young children. Very affectionate & loving towards them. Walks on a lead very well. Gentle & patient :)

NAME: Harley
TEXT: Meet Harley, a cheerful and easygoing companion. This friendly fella has a personality that's as warm as the summer sun, making him an ideal addition to any family seeking a loyal, loving dog. Harley has a delightful, laid-back nature about him. He is effortlessly sociable, having met small dogs with a friendly yet disinterested attitude, ready to just hang out and enjoy their company without demanding constant interaction. With his infectious happiness and calm, affectionate personality, Harley promises to be a wonderful companion for anyone seeking a peaceful, friendly presence in their life. If you’re ready to welcome an easygoing and friendly buddy into your life, Harley is more than ready to meet you.

NAME: Fergie
TEXT: Meet Fergie, the gentle and friendly canine companion you've been searching for! With her quiet demeanor and loving nature, Fergie is the ideal dog for those who appreciate the company of a sweet and easy-going friend. Fergie is lovely on the leash, making walks a delightful experience rather than a chore. She'll be trotting calmly by your side, content to soak in the scenery with you. Her playful side emerges when you bring out the toys—she'll joyfully chase them down with enthusiasm, even if she prefers not to pick them up. Fergie's calm and unassuming temperament makes her well-suited to a wide range of home environments, She's the perfect furry companion for moments of quiet reflection or a gentle stroll around the neighbourhood.

NAME: Devil
TEXT: Meet Devil, the charming canine companion with a heart of gold and an easygoing nature that makes him a delight to have around. Despite his high-energy name, Devil is the picture of calm, ready to bask in the affection of his favorite people. What Devil really enjoys is playing fetch! While he enthusiastically chases after toys, you might need to encourage him to bring them back. With a patient approach, you'll find he learns new tricks quickly and loves to earn your praise. Devil's easygoing attitude extends to other animals as well. He's content to coexist peacefully with cats but isn't particularly interested in them—he can take them or leave them. So, he would fit well in homes with or without feline friends. Calm cats would be best for Devil. If you're looking for a low-maintenance, loving dog who values companionship and comfort, Devil is the perfect match for your life. Come meet Devil, and discover the loyal friend you've been waiting for!

NAME: Bernie
TEXT: Introducing Bernie, the quintessential chilled canine companion you’ve been looking for! Bernie is the definition of easygoing, and his laid-back demeanor makes him the perfect partner. Bernie's love for food is one of his many endearing traits, and achieving his heart is as simple as offering him his favorite treats. He appreciates the simple things in life and is the type of dog who finds joy in the everyday routine. Whether you’re spending a quiet evening at home or heading out for a casual walk, Bernie is content to be by your side. If you have a penchant for relaxing days and are seeking a loyal, food-motivated friend who's happy and enjoyable to be around, Bernie could be your perfect match.

NAME: Johnny
TEXT: Meet Johnny, a quiet and friendly companion who's ready to fill your home with love and warmth. Johnnie's easygoing nature ensures that he'll easily fit into your daily routine without much fuss. Johnny gets along well with other dogs, and his amiable attitude makes him a great candidate for multi-pet households. He's particularly suited for a laid-back lifestyle, where he can enjoy peaceful moments by your side or spend time playing friends. Whether it's a leisurely walk around the neighborhood or relaxing at home Johnny is keen to be involved Johnny is the perfect fit for a family or individual seeking a loyal and tranquil companion.

NAME: Rose
TEXT: Has grown up around teenage children. Confident & happy go lucky. Loves a fun game of fetch with fluffy toys. Engages in play & affection. Beautiful & she knows it! Sweet natured. With the correct into & supervision, Rose may become good friends with your smaller fluffy pals, kittens & all.

NAME: Alice
TEXT: Say hello to Alice, a cheerful and friendly canine companion whose sunny disposition will warm your heart! Her enthusiasm and easygoing nature make every day feel like an adventure. She gets along wonderfully with small dogs, and her friendly attitude extends to cats as well—she's met them and remained perfectly composed. So with the right cat Alice will fit in perfectly. Adopt Alice and watch as every day becomes brighter with her delightful smile and warm, inviting personality.

NAME: Storm
TEXT: Relaxed & very loving older lady. Has spent time around grandchiildren. Storm is a confident girl looking for a life of leisure. She will do well on her own, with full time workers..... or if you might consider welcoming 2 beautiful ladies into your life, Storm’s sister, Chucky is also available :)

NAME: Turbo (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Turbo! This sweet and energetic boy is ready to race into your heart. He could live with a calmer medium/large sized canine friend in his forever home - Pending a Meet & Greet at our Londonderry centre. Turbo is the perfect combination of playful energy and loving companionship, who is quick to learn and takes training in stride, making him a highly trainable and adaptable companion. While he’s eager to be loved, Turbo will need some time to settle into his new home and access to a backyard or small outdoor space where he can stretch his legs and avoid any accidents, would suit him best. Give this playful & happy boy a chance, and you'll gain a friend for life. He's available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Chucky
TEXT: Sweet & adorable older gal. Independant & confident. Will adpat to full time workers. Has spent time around young grandchildren. Relaxed in new spaces & around new people. Sister to Storm! Would you consider welcoming both into your family?

NAME: Casey
TEXT: Meet Casey, a gentle and quiet presence looking for a loving new family to call her own. This sweet-natured girl might be a bit shy at first, but once she gets to know you, her affectionate spirit shines through. Casey is good with all dogs and children. Her adaptable temperament and polite demeanor make her an ideal addition to any family. Her experience with young ones means she's great with kids, and her patience and gentle nature ensure a seamless fit into a family atmosphere. While she thrives in quieter settings where she can relax and take her time adjusting, Casey will enthusiastically come out of her shell once she feels comfortable. If you're looking for a devoted, mild-mannered, and sweet-hearted canine companion, look no further than Casey. Her loving disposition and peaceful spirit make her the kind of dog who can turn a house into a warm, welcoming home.

NAME: Arrie
TEXT: Gentle, loving & kind sweetheart. Confident in new spaces. Relaxed & easy going. Has grown up around children. Good around other/ smaller breeds of dogs. Affectionate. Couch potato. Arrie’s brothers Azi, is also searching for his new home. Perhaps you might consider welcoming 2 beautiful boys into your home?

NAME: Harriet
TEXT: Please meet Harriett- the sweetest, most loving little lady. Very engaging & affectionate. Loves snuggles & kisses. Small in size & the cutest little tail. Has grown up around young children- loves them! Good around smaller breeds of dogs.

NAME: Amy
TEXT: Meet Amy, a gentle and affectionate pup with a heart of gold. Although she's a bit shy at first, once Amy warms up, she reveals her fun-loving personality and loyal nature. Amy is a social butterfly when it comes to her canine companions. She's met small dogs and is exceptionally well-behaved with them, making her ideal for a family with other pets. A tad reserved at first, Amy thrives in a loving and supportive home environment where she can feel safe and flourish as her true self. Her new family can look forward to her sprouting confidence when she is relaxed and secure. Amy would particularly enjoy a home that values social connections, including visits to the dog park, where she can make friends with dogs she meets. If you are looking for an affectionate and playful addition to your family, Amy could be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Panini
TEXT: The perfect panini consists of: a sprinkle of goofiness, a slice of zoomies and a handful of smooches! Panini is ready to join her family on picnics and adventures. This bubbly girl is a super friendly, excited dog with a happy, positive outlook on life. She's interested in all things fun - toys, treats and playtime. If she was to live with children they would need to tolerate her bubbly nature so we recommend kids with big dog experience. She could live in an apartment if she had a fun and stimulating social life! Panini's ideal forever home is one where her family are home more often, so she can receive the love and attention she craves. Panini is ready to pick up and takeaway from our Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Rambo
TEXT: Rambo is enjoying living in a foster home in inner Sydney. In just a few weeks Rambo has come out of his shell and shown himself to be an affectionate, playful, curious and silly boy. His favourite hobbies include napping on the floor, asking for cuddles (and cheese), and of course exploring the neighbourhood on his daily walks. Well-suited for apartment living, Rambo now has his ‘stairs license’ and can confidently climb several floors. Rambo has a lot of love to give, and would therefore thrive in a calm environment. While he’s very obedient and respectful, Rambo is still working on his skills of independence and improving his confidence when being left alone for longer periods of time. He would enjoy a home with a laid back type of life. Known to roach and chill out, Rambo would be an amazing addition for a laid back couple with some hours alone, retirees due to his gentle nature, or a work from home lifestyle, as long as he gets a couple of short toilet walks around the block. He is well versed in being an apartment hound, but of course he would love a backyard if you had one too! Rambo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre. **Rambo is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Indigo
TEXT: Hi, I'm Indigo! I'm SUPER adorable! I'm pretty as a picture, super affectionate and love to cuddle right up on you! I'm still a young curious girl so I'd love to grow up with a family who has a townhouse or backyard for me to do my goofy zoomies in. I would happily live with older kids, too! I would prefer older children as I have a big friendly and fun, bouncy personality. An owner who enjoys ongoing training and who would like to keep showing me the world would be so amazing as I have loved learning new tricks and getting out in the hustle and bustle with my handler. I'd prefer my home without any other pets in it, however I'm friendly with dogs on walks including those smaller dogs I keep seeing around! My perfect home would be someone who works from home/retired so they can spend all their time doting on me and telling me how cute and adorable I am. Finally...I can't let you go without telling you the tricks I know - I'm learning my name means something, so does the word 'yes' and I've even got my stair licence! I'm available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Garnet
TEXT: **Garnet has lived in a foster home in the city CBD with full time workers, is affectionate and intelligent, and loves long walkies and would enjoy an active family to keep fit and go on daily adventures with** She's been a joy to foster! Here's a glimpse into Garnet's wonderful traits: - Garnet is an early bird who enjoys morning naps after joining you in bed. - A fearless adventurer, she's unbothered by much and walks in loud, busy city streets. - Walks in the rain without hesitation. - Patiently waits outside shops while you run quick errands. - Curious by nature, Garnet follows you around, eager to be part of your activities. - Loves to relax and roach on the couch. - Enjoys chasing Frisbees, balls, and playing with squeaky toys. - An exceptional office companion and assistant. - Incredibly friendly and affectionate, she welcomes pats from everyone she meets. - Gentle with children she meets. - Gets super excited about snacks, especially denta sticks! - Loves to taste a variety of foods, from peanut butter, hot chips, and banana. - Garnet has accompanied professional dog walkers, who have consistently praised how well she walks on the lead. Garnet has been a delight in the home, and I'm sure she'll make an excellent addition to a loving family. We’ll certainly miss her! If you're looking for a dog to fill your home with love and joy then apply to adopt the gorgeous Garnet today!

NAME: Piccolo
TEXT: This hound is beautiful calm and polite. She is a quite girl who is sweet and affectionate, she is happy to be at home while your at work.

NAME: Dottie
TEXT: Meet Dottie, a delightful and friendly small dog who will instantly win your heart with her charming personality. She enthusiastically welcomes pats and attention from everyone she meets. Dottie is social with other small dogs and loves making new canine friends. Her outgoing persona makes her the perfect companion for someone who enjoys lively playdates at the dog park. She is fond of being petted and snuggled, and she thrives on the affection and companionship of her humans. Despite her small size, Dottie’s huge heart radiates warmth and happiness wherever she goes. Dottie is eagerly waiting to find her new family to share her love and companionship.

NAME: Patch
TEXT: Patch is a handsome boy, he is very confident and friendly and is in no hurry to be anywhere. This cool calm and collected fellow could suit most homes and he is great company.

NAME: Star (Western Sydney)
TEXT: When you wish upon a star, your dreams come true! Make all of your hopes and dreams come true by welcoming this bright girl into your family! This sweet, playful girl loves to leap around and play bow in the cutest way whenever she gets outside—her energy is contagious! Star is super friendly, affectionate, and loves being with people. She’s great on a lead, though she can be a little goofy at times—after all, she’s just having fun! Star would be happy in a home with respectful kids, and while in the beginning she’s fine being left alone for a few hours, she's open to working her way up to spending longer days alone with some time & patience. Star doesn't mind being the centre of your universe or could also do well with a calmer, respectful dog companion of similar size - making her suitable to a single or multi dog household! She would thrive in a home that has a cozy courtyard where she can let loose and spend her days soaking up the sun. With her good food drive and quick learning, she’s already mastering new things and can't wait to show you what a great addition to your life she can be! Ready to make this sweet girl part of your family? Reach out to the team at Londonderry now! 💫

NAME: Lily
TEXT: Lily has a super sweet and affectionate personality. She is confident meeting new people and will make sure you make lots of friends when you are strutting around town with Lily trotting by your side! She is highly affectionate & will jump up and cuddle into her humans, loves to lean in for more pats and definitely knows the word "cuddles". Lily doesn't mind a few hours alone per day, providing she has access to yard or courtyard type environment. Lily has shown polite manners with other greys, so a home with a medium-larger canine companion would be ok with her. A home with respectful children would be more than ok with him as she has plenty of energy to share the love amongst the whole family. She can’t wait to find her forever home! She is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bindi
TEXT: Bindi is an adorable little girl with a sweet little personality. She is a friendly bundle of love, who has been socialised around children, other dogs and some exposure to family life, helping her step paws into your new world effortlessly! Bindi would enjoy a home with another medium to large hound and a courtyard/backyard to practise those daily zoomies we all know and love. Her entertaining personality would suit respectful children! Bindi is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Terry
TEXT: Are you looking for a gorgeous young boy to join your family? Terry has been learning about the big wide world and can't wait to show you his pet skills! He has been socialised with staffy and kids, and socialised in backyard and home environments. He will quietly approach strangers and happily receive pats, showing off his resilient and quiet nature. We think a home with a courtyard or backyard would suit Terry perfectly as he grows up along side his new family. As he has been socialised with dogs and children, he would make a wonderful family pet for a home with dogs or children. Terry is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Rose
TEXT: Rose will flourish and bloom in a quiet home. Rose would like to grow her roots strong in a backyard or courtyard setting where she can enjoy the breeze and sunshine. She is partial to a crate but not a requirement for her forever home. She's a calm and gentle little petal who is a bit reserved once in the big wide world but is showing to cope well in new situations here! Rose really shines with other dogs around, so a home where she could be picked to join a doggie crew would suit her wonderfully! Rose is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jack (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Introducing Jack, a gentle hound with a personality as charming as his name. He’s affectionate and playful, and there's nothing he loves more than being an affectionate, curious little guy, sure to win your heart. Jack loves riding in the car, not only that but we've noticed he is gentle and follows direction nicely, showing his ability to learn. He socialises well with kids and could go home with respectful children. All the perfect elements of a wonderful family pet! Offering both companionship and entertainment, Jack is just waiting for someone like you. This is a call to all those who have a love of car rides, and the wonderful curiosities of life; Jack is ready to be your partner in discovery. Let the adventure begin! Jack is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Rissole
TEXT: Rissole is a handsome blue boy. Described as a happy, cheerful bubbly boy, we think he could live with older kids and would be content with a courtyard or backyard to call his own. He can be shy when you first get to know him, so a home who enjoy bringing a dog out of their shell will be the best fit for this pretty boy. We have noticed he is more confident around other hounds, and would suit a home with another doggie pal, but not a requirement. He is looking for a quiet loving home - could it be you? Rissole is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jay
TEXT: Known as Mr Confident at the centre, Jay has been around the grand kids aged 5+.He loves everyone and love trips to the park. Not only that but this beautiful boy travels well and is adaptable in new situations, making him a great addition to a fun loving family. Jay is polite and calm, affectionate and friendly. This lovely boy will make a perfect addition for homes looking for your quintessential greyhound - laid back, affectionate, quirky and goofy. He walks nicely on the lead, showing off his lovely gentle nature he's known for! Jay is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Cath
TEXT: Hi, I’m Cath, I’m a sweet and affectionate young lady looking for a family who will love me forever. I am such a delightful, charming little girl with an affectionate, quiet nature. I would enjoy a backyard or townhouse to enjoy indoor/outdoor living. I am full of love and life, but the perfect blend of playful and calm, making me a perfect addition to a home looking for a loving companion. I am a little bit shy but I am an 'eager to please' kinda girl who loves treats - making me easy to train in your home. Like all greyhounds, I do have a little burst of energy and will zoom around and play with my toys, but don’t worry as soon as I’m finished you will find me in bed or laying in the sun. If you think this I could be suited to your home then apply to meet me today at our Londonderry site.

NAME: Maxie
TEXT: Gentle boy Maxie is a friendly and affectionate boy who is gentle on the lead, confidently learning about the world around him. Maxie's best home? He says he would love a courtyard, or backyard to enjoy. He could enjoy his new home with another greyhound pal but not a necessity for this cute lad! Maxie's love of treats will help him become the perfect pet for you. He has been sniffing out the perfect home, and he thinks it could be you! If his puppy dog eyes haven't sucked you in, just come on down to meet him! Maxie is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Mary
TEXT: Truly the Queen of hearts, your Royal Highness Queen Mary requires a new palace in which to rest her crown. Mary will have you charmed from day one. She would love a home where someone will be home more often than not; someone who works part time would be ideal. Mary is also polite and social - having been experienced with kids ranging from 6 years old and up. If Mary had to share her palace, she wouldn’t mind sharing it with another large canine companion but it is not a necessity. If you believe your Majesty Mary will suit your palace, she is currently at our Londonderry facility ready and waiting for adoption (and the red carpet to be rolled out).

NAME: Anna
TEXT: Anna is a hound that would suit people with an active lifestyle. She would be ready for an adventure, she is great company and she does enjoy downtime also. She is vibrant and very friendly, she is good company.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: Billy is a nice confident boy. He is social and playful and is happy to chill out around the house. Very frindly with adults and children.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Charlie is a very handsome hound with a lovely personality to match. He is a sweet gentle boy who would fit into most lifestyles. He is great company and gets on well with everyone.

NAME: Eddy
TEXT: Eddy has spent some time in a foster care home with a female greyhound! Eddy is a handsome, confident and affectionate boy. He will reward his lucky family with lots of tail wags and kisses. Eddy would enjoy a home with human companionship during the day and/or a canine friend. He loves his routine and will walk nicely on the lead for you, greeting people on walks like the lovable boy he is. He has even done well going to his foster carers workplace and settled the entire day confidently in an office environment, making him a great addition to a pet friendly office. Older kids would enjoy his affectionate nature, but when excited Eddy will bounce around so kids with big dog experience would be best. He has conquered things like using a doggy door confidently on day 1, and happily walks up and down stairs too - showing his resilient nature. If Eddy sounds like the right man for you then apply to adopt him today!

NAME: Major
TEXT: Major - more like majorly cute! This handsome boy has been around kids 6+ and other greyhounds, too. He travels beautifully making him a great addition for adventures in the future! He would enjoy a slow and steady pace when entering his forever home so he has some time to adjust to his new life. He would love a home where he is a beloved member of the family with indoor outdoor access, a courtyard or backyard would suit him nicely! Major is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Hero
TEXT: Gentle and unbothered, yep Hero is a total catch! Read on for more details... this boy will just melt your heart! This gorgeous old man would benefit from a nice relaxed life, life in the slow lane please! He has made good progress at the adoption centre, adjusting to the daily training activities like a champ! He is a friendly boy who enjoys human company and will boop you gently for attention and rub his face on you for some more pats - please - winning over the hearts of everyone at the centre. He walks beautifully on a loose leash with a nice, slow pace. His gentle nature extends to his friendliness with other greyhounds, too, making him a stunning companion for a likeminded, laid back greyhound. Shorter hours alone would suit this senior man best, so he can continue to get the TLC and the adoration from his family that he deserves. He is great indoors and could suit apartment living, at the moment we think a courtyard or townhouse would suit him best. Hero is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Astro
TEXT: Yep, Astro is astronomically cute! This gorgeous boy is looking for a quiet backyard, with or without a dog, he's even friendly with small dogs! What a polite and lovely boy....read on to learn more! This sweet boy is currently learning our stairs, to gain his stair licence, one step at a time. He is best suited for shorter hours with or without a doggie pal while he learns to settle in. He's also learning to be friends with cats - watch this space! A backyard with indoor outdoor access and a quiet home who can nurture Astro into the best pet will be the best match for him. Astro is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Blaze
TEXT: Meet Blaze! Blaze is a fun-loving and confident 2-year-old brindle greyhound with a big personality. She adores playtime and will happily keep herself entertained, but she also loves a good cuddle and will happily lay down for a pat. Having lived both indoors and outdoors with her sibling, Poppy, Blaze is well-adjusted and easygoing. She’s a soft and gentle girl who is perfectly fine with full-time work, making her a great fit for a busy household. If you’re looking for an affectionate and playful companion who will bring energy and love into your home, Blaze is the perfect match!

NAME: Poppy
TEXT: Meet Poppy! Poppy is a sweet and affectionate 2-year-old greyhound with a loving nature and a confident personality. She adores playtime but is just as happy lounging around for a pat. This gentle girl has lived both indoors and outdoors with her sibling, Blaze, and is well-adjusted to different environments. Soft and small in size, Poppy is perfect for someone looking for a low-maintenance but affectionate companion. She’s comfortable being left alone during the day, making her an excellent fit for full-time workers. If you’re after a friendly and loving greyhound who will brighten your home with her playful yet gentle nature, Poppy is the one for you!

NAME: Secret
TEXT: **I am in a foster care home in a unit apartment! Reach out to the team to meet me!** Foster Care Update: "Secret has settled in so well, From day 1 he was so good toilet-training wise, instantly had an understanding of the apartment vs outside at the grassy spots. Usually when we work we've left him alone - he has coped really well. Nothing damaged, no accidents, and I even asked the neighbours to let me know if he whines or howls but they haven't heard a thing. He is very content lounging on his couch corner (or the wood floor on hot days) as long as we're in the room too. He'd honestly lie still for hours." ------ He has lovely leash manners and is so very gentle when taking treats. Secret copes well on his own, is showing to have appropriate manners with other dogs, after some initial excitement and is turning into a big leaner who is super affectionate! We feel Secret would do well in an apartment setting or a home with a yard, either on his own or with a med/large canine friend, respectful children are welcome too! Secret is available now at our Western Sydney facility via appointment only.

NAME: Buzz
TEXT: **I'm currently in a foster home, a unit apartment in the city - Reach out to GAP for more info!* Foster Care Update! "He is very confident with people, he is very sweet and affectionate and loves greeting new people (and they love him). From the start he was always coming up to us for pets and cuddles. He has been very good at learning how to go down the steps slowly and carefully. He has been very good when we leave the house. And he doesn’t cry at night either, he’s perfectly happy in his bed until we come out to take him on his morning walk. For exercise, he would be best suited somewhere where he can access a backyard whenever he likes. He loves walking, but he can only walk for 10-15 minutes or less before becoming quite tired due to the extra exertion of walking on three legs. Which makes him a very low maintenance dog! He really only needs a short morning and evening walk/toilet break, maybe some exercise in the backyard at lunch (he loves playing fetch with his soft toys). Otherwise he’s very happy to snooze the day away. Another great thing is that he loves his food but has no interest in human food - Buzz is perfectly happy lying down next to us when we eat. He’s very well toilet trained, no accidents inside." ------ While I am incredibly confident with being out and about and using stairs, a house with a flat accessible yard is best. I also love small children, however also love licking faces and can have a bit of energy, so older children are preferable to share my home with. I am also A-M-A-Z-I-N-G with training! I know “bed”, my name, “down” and my recall is un-bee-lievable. I would love to bee friends with other dogs of a medium/large size and would happily share my hive with them. So don’t bee a stranger, make a bee-line to the Western Sydney Adoption Centre to meet me today!

NAME: Lenny
TEXT: Hi, I'm Lenny. Western Sydney's newest senior heart throb with the fancy feet! I am very human social will happily greet any person and lean into you! I am great indoors with no toileting accidents. I actually prefer being indoors and could suit apartment living. I like other greyhounds but don't need one in my forever home. I seem to do well on my own, enjoying the independence and time to ponder, and could suit longer hours alone with some practise. I don't mind a crate but it's not essential in my forever home. If you've got a comfortable couch for an adorable wise old man like me, please apply! PS...I cross my legs politely when I lie down. I consider myself quite the fancy boy! I'm a super special lad, please meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Midnight
TEXT: Midnight has socialised with children 1 year old and up, making him a wonderful addition to a growing family looking for a beloved family member. He loves a beanbag and a couch, and is a friendly boy with new people and places. He would love to learn about pet life with you slowly as he has not yet learnt everything there is to know. He would make a great addition to a home with another dog, and is learning to be friendly with small dogs and cats! Very happy, playful yet calm, Midnight is a perfect blend of everything you want in a greyhound. Midnight is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Pattie
TEXT: Meet Pattie, a gentle and gracious senior who has spent her life expertly spreading love and warmth. Pattie has been in the company of children and copes well with if they are polite and well mannered. Pattie is a well-mannered lady who carries herself with a polite serenity, she has been socialised with small dogs and although she would prefer a large companion she is polite around small dogs. Pattie has slowed in her senior years, but she would love a foster home where she can settle and would be the perfect companion for someone looking for an older calm companion.

NAME: Wyatt
TEXT: Looking for your new best friend? Sweet Wyatt is ready to find his forever home after spending the last few years living as a pet. He’s a calm, gentle soul who, given some time to adjust, will settle in to home life and would make an excellent companion for any family. He’s been around young children and is fantastic with them, making him a great addition to a family environment. He’s also shown to be very social with other medium/large sized dogs, so he’d be happy to share his home with a canine companion. This wonderful boy is even well-behaved on the lead, making daily walks a joy. If you're looking for a calm, loving, and family-friendly dog, Wyatt could be your perfect match. Come meet him today and see just how amazing he truly is!

NAME: Ron
TEXT: Meet Ron! 🐾 Ron is a calm, affectionate, and super people-friendly boy looking for his perfect forever home! This sweet boy loves spending time with his humans and is always eager to show affection. Ron has spent time around children aged 7 and older and is wonderful with them, making him an excellent family companion. He also gets along well with the other greyhounds he currently lives with and so could do well in a home with other medium/large size dogs. Ron is looking for a loving family or individual who can provide him with a patient and caring environment where he can thrive. If you’re looking for a gentle and loving dog to add to your home, Ron might just be your perfect match! Come meet Ron today and let his loving nature steal your heart!

NAME: Tara
TEXT: Meet Tara! This affectionate girl thrives on human companionship and is always eager to shower you with love and attention. She’s social with other medium/large sized dogs, so she’d fit in perfectly in a home with other canine companions - Pending a Meet & Greet at our Londonderry location. She also could do well as the only dog, as long as she’s getting all the affection she deserves. Given a little time to settle into her new home and as she adjusts to new surroundings, she’ll quickly show you just how loving and loyal she can be!

NAME: Sandy
TEXT: The face of joy! Sandy is very happy, loves everybody and all dogs, even good with the household cat. What a good boy! He also loves the kids 7 and 11 years old, getting lots of pats and playing with them. He has such a sweet nature and is very gentle and quiet. He loves his walks and is a pleasure to handle on the lead. Sandy also loves toys (especially balls), car rides and would make a fun and happy addition for most households who have the time to give him walks, go on some adventures and run around the yard and play. He is easy to please with love and attention, which he will return in spades. 💌

NAME: Willow
TEXT: Willow is an absolute sweetheart. She is only 24kg and is fun, friendly and playful, but not over the top. She loves everyone and gets along with other greyhounds and small breeds, a fluffy Pomeranian and playing with an active Jug in the backyard. She would also get along with other breeds being an easy-going girl who fits in wherever she goes, also enjoying playing with young teenage kids (13+), toys, footballs and is easy to walk on the lead. Willow is a joy to be around and she's not fussy about what she eats She's has had some house experience but is a quick learner and when she finds her new home she will make a beautiful family girl and love you to the moon and back. 💘

NAME: Nigel
TEXT: Everyone loves a Nigel, especially one this handsome! He is a quiet boy, with a shy but loving personality as he gets to know you. He is gentle and gets along and plays with small dogs (a fluffy Jug), other retired greyhounds and also birds. He likes to sit, just a Nigel thing, he hasn't been trained to. Nigel is such a lovely, easy-going boy who has grown up on the farm and been there all his life. He hasn't lived inside but likes a bed on the verandah or a sheltered patio area. With his calm and undemanding nature, he would make a wonderful companion for a quieter household, workers or retirees. He has bursts of energy to have a play in the yard or just potter around as he pleases and check up on you. He doesn't need a daily walk. Nigel is an old soul in a young body with a loving heart, enjoying his retirement and peace. When he gets a chance, I think he would love to claim a couch or cosy bed to curl up near you. 💙

NAME: Faith
TEXT: You've got to have Faith! She is a gorgeous, sweet and loving little girl who is looking for cuddles and somewhere to call home. She has been inside and is fine with household noises, she'd quite like to stay there, yes please! She hasn't grown up with kids but is a playful, calm and gentle girl who would be accepting of gentle older kids as she gets to know them. She enjoys playing with toys, going on walks, loves water and is great with other greyhounds, Jack Russell and Whippet, also loves people, spending time in the office with her 'mum' and staff so there is always someone around for attention and a pat. 🥰 As well as being an adaptable and sociable girl Faith loves car rides, too - they could mean an adventure is afoot or just time for a nice ride and rest with her peeps. There might even be treats, and new people to meet! She also likes to keep cool in summer in a clam shell pool, having a bath or being hosed down to cool off. Faith could be your new cuddle bug. She would make a wonderful easy-going companion for most homes, young and older. She could live in a townhouse with a yard. 💓

NAME: Arthur
TEXT: And I say HEY! What a wonderful kind of day. If you can learn to work and play and get along with Arthur the greyhound! Arthur is a total cutie pie. He is the star of the show, much like the 90's show! Arthur would enjoy a home without another canine companion, and would prefer his family members to be older children or adults only. He is super polite with other hounds but doesn't need their companionship, so being a solo pet is best for this independent boy. He is a shy boy at heart, but loves smooches and cuddles once you get to know him. A backyard or courtyard would be preferred while he learns the ins and outs of pet life. He can even do stairs, walking on a loose lead, as well as learning some training cues like 'on your bed' and 'off your bed'... Talk about talented! It's a simple message and it comes from the heart, Believe in this (and in Arthur the greyhound) for that's the place to start! Arthur is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Roxy
TEXT: Roxy would be great for a busy family. She is a great companion, very social and confident, she can relax and be left at home while everyone is at work and school. She loves to play, she is very affectionate. She is the full sister to Ronnie- both dogs will be amazing new family members.

NAME: Nacho
TEXT: Taco bout cute! We don't want to make it too cheesy, but in between napping and playtime, we think Nacho's got what it takes to salsa into your life like he's always been there. He doesn't mind if you go out for a few hours, making him suitable for those who are out of the house for long periods, as long as he has backyard access. Nacho’s perfect home is one where he gets daily playtime and enrichment as he does enjoy having fun! Opaque fencing in his backyard will help him thrive! He would also love to spend his days with another greyhound or M-L doggie friend. He is affectionate, friendly and snuggly too. He's learnt a bunch of tricks at the centre like how to do stairs, learning to do 'down' and even shake! Older kids with dog experience would be a great match. He’s looking for a family who can appreciate a dog with a zest for life (and cheesy puns...) Nacho is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre. All you have to do is bring the love (and maybe some chips).

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Meet the one and only Missy. An absolute delight in all aspects of her being, she is extremely playful and still has puppy tendencies, which is why we have said she would suit older children as she doesn't quite know her size. Missy loves to engage for pats and throwing a toy for her but would like to have time to herself and have it respected in her new home. Due to Missy's age she may find adjusting to a new home a little bit hard but she has the confidence to grow and develop if her new parents are interested.

NAME: Elton
TEXT: Elton is a charming boy. He loves cooling off in the water and is a good well balanced boy. He is also a very handsome hound that everyone falls in love with.

NAME: Bell
TEXT: Bell is a beautiful girl living in a semi rural setting. She is lovely company, very affectionate, nice to play with and she relaxes well on her own.

NAME: Jade
TEXT: Jade is a sweet affectionate young hound. She would suit most lifestyles as she gets along with everyone and is playful and affectionate. She is a confident girl who plays well with other dogs big and small.

NAME: Keith
TEXT: Meet Keith – a sweet, friendly, and gentle boy who's looking for his forever home! He loves his treats and is quick to pick up new things, making him a dream to train! Keith also does really well with our other greyhounds on site, and would likely thrive in a home where he has a medium/large sized furry friend by his side. As a single dog, this adorable boy would do best in a household where someone is around more often at first to help him settle in. But, if his new home has another doggie pal to keep Keith company he probably wouldn't mind too much if his people are gone during the day! He’s been on his best behaviour while spending time inside, but would still like to have access to a backyard or courtyard while he gets used to his new home. If you’re looking for a loving and affectionate dog, Keith could be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Cheezel
TEXT: All aboard the love train, destination Cheezel! This gorgeous boy has a super sweet and affectionate personality and just loves to snuggle right into you for maximum pats! He's a confident and smart boy, already having mastered many pet skills here at the GAP centre, including laying on his bed on cue, waiting patiently when doors are opened, dropping toys when asked, leaving food when asked, coming when called and shaking your hand! What a clever boy! Although he loves to spend some time inside with his people, Cheezel would love a home that also has a backyard for him to enjoy and play in. He is quite content spending the day by himself snoozing in the sun, making him a great fit for full-time workers. Cheezel is suitable for older kids/teenagers, but would prefer to be the only pet in the household so he can soak up all the love for himself! Cheezel is a crowd favourite here at GAP and we know you will just love him too! If Cheezel sounds like the boy for you, then apply to adopt him today!

NAME: Cookie
TEXT: Cookie is a friendly & social girl looking for her new home where she will be surrounded by love and attention! She’s very human-focused and loves being around people, always displaying positive consent and gentle affection. Whether it’s playtime or cuddle time, she’s sure to brighten your day! Cookie does very well walking calmly on a lead, making walks a relaxed and enjoyable experience. She’s also shown to be good around our other greyhounds, and could be happy sharing her new home with another medium/large doggie friend - Pending a Meet & Greet at our Western Sydney site. Contact us today to learn more about this lovely girl and discuss booking in an appointment to meet her!

NAME: Wynstan
TEXT: Wynstan with a Y here...let me tell you a bit about myself! I hope you like a happy affectionate boy, if so, read on! I love to lean on my handlers and show off my adorable affectionate nature. Did anyone tell you I'm also polite with big and small dogs? Seriously, I'm a catch! I'm also all about my treats, so if you're looking to teach me tricks, please involve snacks too! This will help me settle in and learn how to be the best pet for you. Everyone says I'm amazing, so I guess they love how I walk so nicely and gently on the lead for walkies, too! I'm available from the Western Sydney adoption centre, see you soon!

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Hi I'm Millie! I'm a friendly, happy girl who loves to greet you with a big smile. I'm an affectionate girl who promises to walk nicely on the lead for our daily adventures, making me a great fit for families or couples looking for an adventure buddy. I don't mind if you have respectful children or other larger breed dogs at home, as I've shown I'm a friend to greyhounds here. I'm ideally looking for a home with a bit of a townhouse or backyard, but I promise to be by your side for snuggles at night. I'm available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Matey
TEXT: Ahoy Matey! Matey is the finest gem of them all! With his pretty blue coat, floppy ears and happy go lucky energy, this Matey is a bounty of charm waiting to be adopted! Matey has spent some time in a foster care home and we have learnt he loves spending time with his family and going for a quiet sniffari around the block! He is a super outgoing boy who just loves everyone he meets, especially if you have some yummy treats or play a game of fetch with him! Matey is an enthusiastic and fun-loving boy making him suitable for those wanting a playful companion and would do best in a home without young kids or other pets. Matey suits part-time or full-time workers provided he lives in a quiet area with opaque fencing so he can just relax and snooze the day away in the backyard. Get ready to meet your new best Matey! This handsome boy is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Flossy
TEXT: Flossy is a beautiful young girl. She is playful and affectionate. Gets along with everyone she meets. She is great with young kids and would make a perfect fit for a family.

NAME: Paul
TEXT: Paul is a stunning boy who is great to play with, can be left alone. He is social and confident with other dogs and a good walker on the lead.

NAME: Andy
TEXT: Andy is a lovely boy, he is very confident and obedient. Knows his name and is good to walk on the lead. Has had exposure to various native animals living in a rural area.

NAME: Archie
TEXT: Archie is a fun playful young hound. He plays well with kids, he is a happy boy who relaxes easy on his own and likes to relax after playtime. He walks well on the lead and is starting to get some house experience.

NAME: Flint
TEXT: Flint is a polite gentleman when it comes to people & other dogs. He would suit a calm canine friend in his forever home. He’s all about manners and will leave you impressed with how well he interacts with both humans and other greyhounds. Flint is quick to learn and takes training in stride, making him a highly trainable and adaptable companion. While he’d love to be an inside dog, indoor outdoor access to a backyard or small outdoor space (eg courtyard) where he can stretch his legs and avoid any accidents, would suit him best. Flint is a polite young man who can't wait to meet you. He's available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Faye
TEXT: This adorable and gentle girl is looking for fun loving home to call her own! Faye is an adorable girl who is friendly with people she meets. Maybe you're retired, work from home or live a chilled life, as she prefers someone around more often than not. She would enjoy a home where she is going to be a beloved family member, including hanging out indoors or spending time playing outdoors in the sunshine. Faye would suit a home with another likeminded greyhound or even older children who are respectful. Sweet little Faye is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Mj (Mary Jane)
TEXT: This pretty young girl is very affectionate and social. She is a small curious hound who looks to suit a courtyard or townhouse environment. She likes to play and go for a walk and she loves to relax and take it easy.

NAME: Star
TEXT: Star is a gentle and affectionate greyhound who adores human companionship but is also perfectly content spending time alone during a busy workday. She’s incredibly respectful and gentle when receiving pats, making her a delight to be around. Star enjoys lazing the day away, especially in a clam swimming pool, and is easy to walk on a lead. Having been raised around farm animals and wildlife, she is well-mannered in different environments and is considered cat workable. Currently living with another greyhound, Star would make a wonderful addition to a loving home, whether as a solo companion or alongside other pets.

NAME: Ace
TEXT: Ace is a playful and gentle young hound. He was very friendly and nice when he met my daughter and was good company with a good balance of being playful and affectionate. Gets along great with other greyhounds.

NAME: Katie
TEXT: Katie is a lovely hound. She is happy and confident, very playful. Does appreciate a good lay down also. Has been living in a rural setting is no stranger to native animals.

NAME: Toby (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *Toby is in a foster care home with a female greyhound and a male Jack Russell - reach out to the team to organise a meet and greet** Update from foster: Like all dogs, he needs/loves his routine. He is very cheery and playful, especially with the small dog, playing and teasing together. In the house, he can be cheeky and try to pick up and play with human items. (We close bedroom and lounge doors.) He definitely needs another dog as his mate. He needs a reasonably calm, reassuring environment. Loves his food, but is not a gulper. Loves his walks, and is very good on the leash. (A bit of a sticky beak, so sometimes you have to let him stop and observe for a bit.) Is totally at ease with other dogs and people he has met. He is very observant and "switched on'. It's ok for his humans to be out for the whole day, as long as he has a mate with him. But he still needs human interaction when his people come home. Toby is a very social dog, both with other dogs and people. We've never had an issue with him toileting inside. He sleeps right through the night. Toby is better suited to a forever home with regular companionship, whether it be a human or another doggie pal. Once settled in his forever home, Toby will lie on his mat and sleep/relax for quite some time. Toby loves being with you, but is happy to observe or go off investigate/lie down and relax, keeping out of your way. If Toby sounds like the adorable, loveable boy you have been searching for contact GAP today! **Toby is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Flash
TEXT: Flash is seeking an empathetic & nurturing owner who can follow a cooperative care plan to help with his daily eye medication. Could you be the perfect owner for our sweet boy? Flash has advanced pannus, which means he needs daily eye medication. But don’t worry—he’s a star pupil when it comes to taking his meds & he’s getting better every day with the right guidance. Flash is currently learning all sorts of new tricks at the adoption centre. He is a fast learner and with a little time and practice, he's shown he can do amazing things. A large yard where Flash can stretch his legs and zoom around is a must! He loves a good run, and a big space is perfect for his energy. No small children or other animals. Flash would prefer a calm environment where he can be the only one getting your attention and affection. Flash is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre. **Flash is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Brockie
TEXT: This lad is very social and affectionate, he is great with kids, gets along with all the dogs he has met big and small. Would be great for a family.

NAME: Skylar
TEXT: Skylar is a gentle and loving girl looking for someone who is on the lazier side to enjoy life with. Skylar is a beautiful fawn girl who enjoys sleeping the day away whilst you are at work. Skylar has spent time living in a townhouse and is more comfortable inside by your side then outside. Skylar walks very well on lead and jumps in and out of the car to go for drives. Skylar is still very social with people in the streets but does enjoy relaxing on her bed watching your favourite tv show with you.

NAME: Alex
TEXT: Meet Alex, an incredibly fun and playful greyhound with a heart full of energy and charisma! He loves playing games with toys and is always up for a good fetch session. Alex would thrive in a home with a spacious backyard where he can run and play to his heart’s content. He’s especially fond of older kids who can keep up with his playful nature. If you're looking for a joyful, active companion, Alex might just be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Meet Spot, our distinguished older gentleman who is looking for the perfect match. Spot isn't just any dog; he carries himself with the grace and ease that only a seasoned greyhound can. Spot has had the pleasure of living in the serene setting of a granny flat, making him an expert in enjoying the quieter side of life. However, don’t let his age fool you; thanks to a thorough training program, Spot is sharp and responsive. He comes eagerly when his name is called and possesses a well-mannered set of tricks, including "touch" and "paws up," that make him a delight to teach and interact with. His training, combined with his naturally loyal temperament, makes Spot an excellent fit for a single person looking for a true companion. He understands the comforting routine of a single household and offers unwavering loyalty in return. Spot embodies the best qualities of an older dog. Devoted and endearing, he is ready to join someone who values thoughtful companionship and has room in their heart for a truly dignified and loving friend.

NAME: Hope
TEXT: Meet Hope, a loyal companion ready to bring joy and companionship to her lucky new family. She lives up to her name with her quiet demeanor and dignified presence, making her the perfect "queen" of her domain. Hope has completed an eight-week training program, learning touch, recall, paws up and other fun behaviours. She thrives as an only pet, making her ideal for a home where she can be the centre of your attention. This loyal lady loves her treats and relishes playtime with her beloved shell pool. Imagine the joy of watching her happily splashing around, leaving wet paw prints and smiles in her wake. She delights in lounging around a yard where she can bask in the sun and enjoy quiet moments. Hope is ready to make a home her own, will you be the one to welcome her into your life? Hope is available for foster for the right person who would be happy to give her a comfortable retirement home in her aging years.

NAME: Katie (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Playful, friendly and confident, white and black spotty 2 year old Katie is adorable inside and out! Katie walks nicely on the lead, loves greeting people and checking out what's going on. She loves everyone she meets and is a total social butterfly. We think she would do best in a home with canine, or human companionship throughout the day to make sure this extroverted girl gets all the attention she deserves. She gets along with big or small dogs, making her well suited to a home with another dog of any size. Her happy nature would see her best suiting a home with older children, as sometimes when she's excited she forgets her size! She is still young and has a lot to learn about pet life but she has an amazing can do attitude & can't wait to be a part of your world forever! Katie is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Derick
TEXT: Derick is a handsome and lively 4-year-old greyhound with striking colouring inspired by the Tasmanian devil. He’s a playful and affectionate boy who adores attention and thrives on human companionship. While he gets excited during playtime and when he sees his lead—often jumping with joy—he quickly settles down and walks beautifully on a lead. Derick has been socialised around other greyhounds, and would make a fun and loving addition to an active person looking for a loyal companion.

NAME: Kenneth
TEXT: Kenneth is a sweet gentle soul who is a darling on the lead and an overall laid back boy. Being middle aged, he's ready to take it easy and enjoy the retirement life. He's a friendly and affectionate boy who is suitable to live with respectful children and big or small doggies. Suitable for a backyard/townhouse, this laid back boy suits many home types! He has the sweetest little face with an adorable personality to match. Come meet Kenneth at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Joe
TEXT: Are you looking for a calm, mega chill, laid back boy to join your world? Maybe you've seen those amazing pet greyhounds out on walkies in the big wide world and thought you'd like your very own amazing boy? Well I'm laid back, confident, walk well with my head held high! I'm ready to meet you and show you how amazing I am! I'm relaxed, quiet, gentle, and laid back. I'm super friendly with other dogs including small dogs. I could totally suit a home with respectful children as I am a total love bug. I am available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Devil (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Despite my naughty name, I'm a very sweet boy! I'm a quiet lad looking for a home to enjoy my zoomies and snooze in the sun. I even walk nicely on the lead making me a great friend for daily strolls. I'm known to be calm and friendly, and love a good pat. I would suit a home with respectful children as I am a gentle boy. A home with big or small dogs would suit me well, too, as long as they're chill and likeminded. I can't wait to meet you! I'm available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Rose Maree
TEXT: Meet Rose Maree, a truly gorgeous and sweet canine companion ready to steal your heart. Rose Maree enjoys the simple pleasures in life, like lazing in the shade on a sunny day, where she can unwind and watch the world around her. Playtime is something Rose Maree cherishes, and toys are her absolute favourite. This lovely girl thrives on fun and interaction, especially when playing with kids. Her playful energy shines through when she's chasing a ball keeping young ones entertained for hours. . Rose Maree's ideal home is one where she can bask in sunshine and have access to plenty of toys and loving playmates. She loves spending time with her family and taking in the blissful outdoors. If you're looking for a playful companion to add warmth and joy to your family, Rose Maree is ready to join you on a sun-dappled adventure!

NAME: Tree
TEXT: Looking for a dog who’s part rocket, part couch potato, and 100% lovable? Say hello to Tree, a 2.5-year-old Greyhound who’s ready to plant his roots in your heart (and maybe your lap). Tree is a certified people-person in dog form- he thrives on attention, affection, and the occasional belly rub. If you’re home more often than not, Tree will be your shadow, your cuddle buddy, and your biggest fan. He’s got great recall and walks like a dream on the leash, so he’s always up for a stroll, as long as it’s by your side. Playful and full of life, Tree loves to let loose in a yard – he’s got energy to burn would rather zoom than doom-scroll any day. While he’s a big dog with big love to give, he’s still figuring out that not all small dogs appreciate his enthusiasm. Larger canine companions are more his vibe, so he’d prefer a household where the pint-sized pups don’t steal the show. Bonus points: Tree is stair-savvy, lap-approved, and ready to bring a whole lot of fun into your life. If you’re looking for a sweet, affectionate companion who’s as happy sprinting as he is snuggling, Tree might be your perfect match.

NAME: Lulu
TEXT: Lulu is a delightful and well-rounded greyhound who brings a perfect mix of fun and relaxation to any home. In the yard by herself, Lulu is quiet and calm, making her an easy addition to a full-time working family. She’s wonderful with children and enjoys playing games, especially chasing balls and playing with toys. While she has an energetic, playful side, she quickly settles down and enjoys relaxing with her loved ones. Lulu is a dream to walk on lead and travels comfortably in the car, making her an excellent companion for outings or adventures. If you’re seeking a loyal, playful, and gentle addition to your home, Lulu is ready to meet you.

NAME: Bill
TEXT: Salt & pepper faced Bill may look like one of our special seniors but this gorgeous 3 year old boy is still a youngen, and we know him to be super affectionate! He loves to lean on his people for pats, making it hard to get a good photo! Bill would suit a relaxed and laid back home with or without children. A few hours alone will suit Bill well, and full time hours with a doggie companion, too! We think Bill will make an amazing addition to so many home types. He is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Chandler
TEXT: Meet sweet & beautiful Chandler... Chandler is a gentle and polite male greyhound with a calm and relaxed demeanor. He’s a sweetheart who greets everyone warmly and enjoys a good snuggle, especially after a sunbath. Chandler has been around older kids and medium-sized dogs, and he gets along well with both. He’s also a joy to walk on a lead, making him the perfect companion for leisurely strolls. Whether lounging in the sun or curled up for some quiet time, Chandler is sure to bring a sense of calm and affection to any home.

NAME: Squirt
TEXT: Tiny little girl Squirt is looking for a loving home!
