Young Squirt is a bit of shy girl who would benefit most from a quiet and relaxed home willing to take new things nice and slow as she adjusts to the wonders of pet life. With a bit of time and patience you will see Squirt’s super sweet personality start to come out and she will wiggle in close to you for a pat and a treat. You might even get to experience her hilarious playful zoomies! Squirt would love a backyard to chill out in and wouldn’t mind at all if her new humans are full-time workers. She absolutely loves other medium/large dogs and would gladly share her new home with one. In fact, we have noticed Squirt finds a lot of confidence having a canine friend to lead the way! Could you be Squirt’s special someone? She is available for foster or adoption at our Western Sydney adoption centre! *Squirt is on daily medication – ask staff for more info!*

NAME: Noel
TEXT: Christmas has come early and boy do we have the best gift for you! Introducing the always merry and bright Noel! Noel is a sweet and gentle boy suited to those looking for a calm natured companion. He is a low maintenance guy who is quite happy to chill at home during the day while his human parents are at work. He is friendly with other medium/large dogs and would gladly share his new home with another calm doggy friend. Noel would do best in a quieter home without young kids, but older kids/teens that respect his space are suitable. Noel has lovely lead manners and would be happy to join you on a daily stroll. The key to his heart is food! He loves his treaties making him easy to train and entertain with enrichment games. So jump on in your sleigh and come on down to the Western Sydney adoption centre to meet Noel!

NAME: Chino
TEXT: **Chino has just gone into a foster care home - check back for updates!** Order up! One tall and fluffy Chino, brewed to perfection with a dash of sweetness, is ready to find his forever home! Chino is looking for a cozy spot where he can enjoy a laid-back retirement, sipping on the peaceful moments of life. He's got a smooth, mellow, personality, but every now and then, he perks up for a playful burst – just like that shot of espresso when you need it most. His favorite thing? Leaning into you for the ultimate cuddle, because he's all about getting those extra pats! Chino is a friend to dogs of all sizes and would love to share his home with a canine companion. If he's the only pet in your cup of tea, part-time workers are just the right blend for him, but with a doggy friend, he’s content to chill solo for longer hours. Chino’s chill vibe makes him a great fit for families with kids, as long as he’s got his own little nook to unwind in when he needs a break. If you think Chino would be the perfect addition to your family, apply online today – he’s ready to be your new favourite brew!

NAME: Sting
TEXT: Get ready to feel the Sting of love from this handsome boy! With his confident personality and loving nature, Sting is ready to take on the world, whether it’s playing in the backyard or having a cuddle session. Sting would thrive with an owner who can match his energy and provide plenty of love and attention. He would be open to sharing his new home with another furry friend, pending a meet & greet with the GAP team. He also has the potential to work up to longer hours alone, but would like he family or another furry companion with him to help settle in the early stages. If you’re looking to welcome a dog who’s full of personality and ready to make your life even more exciting, Sting might be the one for you!

NAME: Tiger
TEXT: Roaring into your heart, one paw at a time! Tiger is ready to bring excitement and joy to your life. While he may need some time to adjust, once he feels at home, Tiger will become your best companion. Scar would love a courtyard or backyard to laze around and have the occasional play in. He could suit a home with another medium/large breed dog if they can respect his more reserved nature. If you're looking for a sweet and affectionate friend, Tiger is waiting to meet you. Can you be the one to give this sweet boy the home he deserves?

NAME: Scar
TEXT: Don’t let his name fool you, Scar is a softie at heart. Though he may take a little time to warm up, once he feels comfortable, Scar’s friendly and affectionate nature will shine through. Scar would thrive in a calm environment with a family who can work with him to learn how to be the best furry companion he could be. Scar is open to sharing his home with another medium/large furry friend - pending a meet & greet at our Londonderry site. With some patience and training he also has potential to be able to be built up to spending longer periods of time alone. If you’re ready to give him the time and care he needs, Scar will reward you with loyalty and love.

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Meet Benji, a sweet and excitable boy who’s looking for his perfect forever home! Despite Benji nearing his senior years, he'll still win your heart over with his playful antics and would love a home with a courtyard or backyard to spend his time playing and sunbaking in. Benji has been around children of all ages in his previous home and could do well in a household with experienced children who can appreciate his enthusiastic nature. If you're ready to welcome a loving, loyal friend into your life, Benji can’t wait to meet you and be a part of your family!

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Charlie is a playful energetic boy. He is very friendly and likes to play and be around people. He is very friendly with kids of all ages he could possilby get clumsy with little kids since he thinks he is a small dog.

NAME: Banjo
TEXT: Banjo is a sweet boy who is very relaxed and comfortable. He does like to play, go for walks and enjoys a swim. He would suit multiple homes since he is so laid back and relaxed.

NAME: Jax
TEXT: Jax is a fun young hound who likes to play go for walks and enjoys a good rest afterwards. He lives in a suburban backyard and is conditioned to being left alone during full time work hours. He comes when called and enjoys a walk.

NAME: Macca
TEXT: Macca is a gentle boy with a heart full of love that he is ready to share with his new family! He enjoys quiet moments and would love a peaceful environment with a yard where he can unwind, but don’t be fooled—he still enjoys his occasional zoomies! He would do well in a home who can appreciate his shy nature and work on building his confidence so he can be the best pet he can be. If you’re looking for a calm, loving, and loyal companion, Macca is eager to meet you.

NAME: Rusty (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Rusty, a lovable and energetic boy who is ready to find his forever home! Rusty is a friendly companion who has had a brief introduction to pet life in his previous home - spending some time indoors, being taken on public walks and also meeting new people, including children! His warm, golden fur is as soft as his heart, and he’ll quickly become your new best friend and would do well in a home where he can get plenty of attention, exercise, and affection. If you're looking for a dog who will bring joy to your life, Rusty might be the perfect fit. Come meet him today—he can’t wait to share his love with you!

NAME: Gus
TEXT: Gus the Gentle Giant (40kg) is just a goofy, happy, friendly, placid boy. He will walk beside you and potter around with you when you are home, a lovely companion. He can walk up the stairs to the verandah where he's happy to lie. Gus is social with other people and is good with the 2-year-old and 4-year-old grandsons who visit. He is used to garden noises and is not worried by storms. Gus loves a bit of a run, doing a few zoomies and a play in the backyard but is essentially pretty chill and lazy and doesn't need daily walks! He doesn't bark at dogs (kelpies) running past the fence but has not been around any small dogs or cats. He is fine being on his own for the day after his morning 'run' and doesn't need a daily walk if he has a decent backyard for exercise. Gus would be a lovely gentle boy for companionship, love and easy care with his lovely temperament.

NAME: Dally
TEXT: Dally is a sweet, loving gorgeous big boy! At 38kg he's a hunk of love who loves people and just wants to be around you. He spends time in the office and loves spending time with the staff and going for walks with them in the yard. Dally is great with other dogs, especially the many retired greyhounds he lives with, and more so with larger dogs than little one or cats. He would be more suited to being around older children, but he wouldn't hurt a fly, just a friendly stickybeak! This laid-back dude would suit anyone wanting a 'happy chappy' furry friend for life. What a special, teddy-bear, cuddle-bug! 🥰

NAME: Becky
TEXT: Becky is a fun loving young girl who LOVES snuggles! Despite Becky's fun loving & enthusiastic energy, she still has a lot to learn! Becky doesn't realise she's not a lap dog, and will get right in there for a cuddle! She is still learning her social skills with other dogs and would benefit from further training to learn to be calm and polite around other dogs. We know she definitely means well, though! Maybe too friendly! She needs a home who will give her lots of cuddles and be home more often than not as she thrives on human company. Maybe you work from home and need a snuggle buddy. She has learnt a lot here at the centre on top of growing her confidence and manners. She has even learnt her name/recall, and what the word yes and bed means! Becky would suit respectful children and a house with a yard. Becky is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Captain
TEXT: A’hoy, Captain! Captain ready and waiting for his future home and family, could you be that lucky person?! He is searching through his spyglass in all of the seas, but we think maybe a home on the land would be better. A backyard, a bed, lots of toys and possibly a medium-large canine friend would do him just fine. He gets on well with the other hounds here at GAP and would love to spend his new life hanging out with some new friends. As well as some treats, yummy meals and walkies would make him so happy. Due to his excitable yet gentle nature, Captain will suit a home with children as long as they are respectful and know when to give him some space if he needs it. He's also spent time around kids 7+. If you’re looking for the perfect family pet, one to make you laugh and show you love, one to play in the yard with during the day and chill with you at night, we think Captain is ready to dock, and if this could be in your yard, let us know. He is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Midas
TEXT: Gentle, calm and a lovely walking companion, Midas will add the glitz and gold to your life. Midas is an affectionate and gentle boy, who shines with attention and love. He would prefer his family around more this summer as he settles in, and with further training could be left for longer hours. Everything he touches will turn to gold...he is a friendly and calm boy looking for a family with or without children to love him forever! Midas is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Queeny
TEXT: Queeny is a happy, very lovable and friendly young girl who loves life! She would be a great addition for a young couple or family with older kids on her own or with another greyhound or medium to large dog. She just wants to be part of your life, be a sticky beak, play, and have fun! She can also settle down and have a rest when needed, inside or out in a large yard. She has been around a lot of people coming and going in an office environment, noises don't worry her. Queeny loves to wander around the yard and play, then sleep inside with other retired greys during the day or in her own indoor kennel. She is used to walking on lead, loves pats and is well-behaved when given love and attention. She would adore a new home to settle into with her own special people be your loyal companion. 🥰

NAME: Billson
TEXT: Bubbly, effervescent and a perfect accompaniment for your life (not only this summer!), Billson is a sweet and joyful hound. He has been around children of all ages and would suit a home with respectful children. A low small dog population is the best fit for Billson as he needs to learn and have more training around them. Upbeat and fun, Billson would suit many home types. He's an energetic lad with some energy to fizz away, so a home with the family members around more often than not would be the best fit for Billson. Grab a slab and join Billson this summer! He is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jimbo
TEXT: Jimbo is a polite, happy and laid back boy best described as chilled out and relaxed. As he is entering his senior years he has a wonderful calm energy. Gorgeous inside and out, this boy is so sweet! He has spent time around other greyhounds, and children, and would suit many home types. He's what greyhound people call a "leaner"! He will lean on you for pats! Jimbo would prefer his family around more often than not while he settles in, and a home with a medium to large doggie friend would see him settle for longer hours. Jimbo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Teddy
TEXT: This adorable boy is the sweetest little guy ever! Teddy is a very friendly and social boy who is calm on the lead, snuggly and friendly with other grey's and even polite with smaller dogs on walkies. Teddy is great with other medium/large sized dogs and would happily join a family who already has one and spend the day with them while his humans are out. As a single dog, Teddy will need someone around more often than not to keep him company. Older, respectful kids are suitable for Teddy and would enjoy his goofy playfulness! So come and cuddle our little Teddy today! He is available from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Trevor
TEXT: Fun, playful, happy and engaging boy Trevor is a sweet friendly boy ready to find a family to call his own. Trevor loves all things fun - treats and toys and good times! Trevor would suit a home with older children who love a bit of playtime, or a family who would let him join all of life's fun activities. Trevor is still learning to be around smaller breeds of dogs and further training would see him thrive into a polite gentleman we know he can be! Trevor currently lives amongst other greyhounds and would enjoy a home with another dog but in lieu of a canine companion, shorter hours alone or workers from home and some mental stimulation while you're out would see Trevor settle right in. Trevor is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Raffa
TEXT: This bundle of joy loves human interaction and adventure. Raffa loves to run around his big yard area and shows you how fast he can be. Raffa gets very excited for the first five minutes you meet him before settling down. After getting his morning energy out and jumping around Raffa settles down and loves to lay in the sun. Raffa is fine around older kids and would make a great pet for a family with a big yard or a young couple who are fit and active.

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Meet Missy, a stunning female red fawn greyhound with a perfect balance of strength and sweetness. Missy can be strong on the lead, making her walks an exciting experience, but she is also incredibly relaxed and calm, adapting well to new environments and settling into a peaceful routine at home. Missy’s playful side shines through when it’s time for fun! She loves engaging with her humans, whether it’s a lively game or simply hanging out and soaking up attention. Her joyful and affectionate nature makes her a delightful companion for an active family or an individual who enjoys both adventure and relaxation. With her combination of strength, playfulness, and a laid-back attitude, Missy is ready to bring her warmth and energy into a loving home. If you’re looking for a dog who will keep you on your toes while also offering plenty of cuddles, Missy could be your perfect match!

NAME: Blake
TEXT: Blake is a beautiful confident boy who loves to be apart of the family. Blake is perfect for a family as he is a gentle mix of playful but also loving and caring. Blake is crate trained overnight in the home and is also well adjusted to being alone for fulltime workers in the backyard during the day. Blake travels well in the car and is confident in new surroundings. With over 3 months house training Blake is perfect for that family who maybe looking to add an extra friend to it.

NAME: Casper
TEXT: Meet Casper, a sweet and gentle soul looking for a loving new family. Casper is a serene and relaxed companion who thrives in calm environments, making him an ideal pet for those who appreciate a soothing home. He might be a bit cautious at first, but with patience and understanding, he will reveal his warm and gentle heart. Casper is relaxed and easygoing when it comes to handling. He'll enjoy sitting quietly by your side, whether you're settling in with a good book or enjoying a leisurely weekend afternoon, Casper will be content to share those peaceful moments with you. Due to his cautious nature, Casper would do best in a quieter home, where he can truly shine at his own pace. If you're a calm and patient adopter looking for a relaxed and loving companion, Casper could be the perfect fit for your lifestyle.

NAME: Ringo
TEXT: Ringo is the handsome fawn boy who is looking for an active person or family to take him on adventures Ringo is fine with fulltime workers and is just excited to go for his daily walk and play. Ringo will sleep and play the day away with some toys or a bone in the backyard whilst you are at work. Ringo has grown up with children as young as 5 years old and loves hanging out with them. Ringo has grown up sharing his yard with his best friends two greyhounds Barber and Penny. Ringo is on the lookout for his perfect match and with some love and care will make the perfect pet

NAME: Wombat
TEXT: He is not short and stumpy, nor does he eat leaves and grass but he is ready to burrow his way into your heart and home. Wombat is a sweet and gentle boy is seeking a family that can be around more often than not, or a canine companion so he company. He gets along well with other canines, medium to large breeds are ok for him to live with pending a friendly meet and greet at GAP. Respectful kiddos would be suitable, too! If you can give Wombat the burrow he is seeking submit an application form to adopt him now. He is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ronald
TEXT: Ronald is a cheerful, confident and friendly lad looking to bounce straight into your home. We know Ronald to be a charismatic, charming and affectionate boy. With these qualities in mind, we think he'd suit a family with children and preferably shorter hours alone while he begins to settle in. This beautiful boy is at the magical age of 6 where he has his lazy side but has moments of playfulness, too. A perfect blend for many family types! Did we mention he currently lives with another greyhound? He'd love it if you had another hound for a play mate and nap buddy. Get in touch with the Western Sydney centre to meet Ronald.

NAME: Jagger
TEXT: He’s got the moves like Jagger! This boy certainly knows how to impress! Jagger is a special boy with a personality that can melt your heart. Jagger has a laid-back and easy-going nature, making him suited a home that has a secure backyard/courtyard type environment. Jagger can adapt to a household where family members work full-time, as long as he receives the love and attention he deserves when they return home. Providing him with a comfortable space and engaging toys during the day can help keep him content. Due to his sweet nature, he is an ideal choice for a home with respectful children seeking a loving companion. He has shown to be polite with other medium to large canine companions. He is a social boy and enjoys the companion of his four-legged friends, if you have other dogs in the home, he will surely enjoy showing them his moves! Be sure to apply online today and mention Jagger’s name in your application, you don’t want to miss out on welcoming this loving, gentle and playful boy to your home.

NAME: Lizzie
TEXT: Meet Lizzie, an easy-going soul with a placid nature and a relaxed temperament that endears her to everyone she meets. Her gentle disposition makes her an absolute pleasure to have around and the perfect addition to a household. A self-confessed couch potato, Lizzie treasures quiet afternoons spent lounging around on the couch. Her favorite pastimes include soaking in the sun from a warm spot by the window. She's compatible with all canine friends she's encountered, including lively Italian Greyhounds and adorable Mini Spoodle, initially she was nervous but adjusted well and had a relaxed and neutral response.

NAME: Bert
TEXT: Bert is ready to find his forever home, this boy has personality+, boasts confidence and loves to come along for pats and cuddles anytime he wants. Bert is social with other greyhounds and spends a lot of time relaxing or playing. He can still be a bit sporadic on lead and excitable but given his age with a the right training and time, he will adapt quickly. Bert would be suited to a house with a backyard so if he has any energy he can have a good explore and play around.

NAME: Oakley
TEXT: Personality plus, yet lazy and laid back when you need him to be, our handsome boy Oakley is perfect for busy families seeking an independent lad with a fun loving streak to join their crew! This cutie is super low maintenance & thrives on simply spending the day relaxing and snoozing outdoors in the yard, making him well suited to full-time workers. When you get home, Oakley will shower you with love and affection! Yep, Oakley really is dreaming of a backyard with opaque fencing to frolic and sunbathe in as he pleases. Oakley is friendly with other medium/large dogs, would suit a home with or without another doggie pal or respectful children & not to mention, he is super engaged during his training sessions here at GAP. Yep, he's a catch! He is available now from our Western Sydney kennels so apply today!

NAME: Costa
TEXT: Meet Cuddle Me Costa, a sweet and affectionate male greyhound who lives up to his name with big, warm cuddles! Costa is a confident, happy boy who loves to shower his family with love. He’s well-socialized with young children and medium-sized dogs, making him a perfect fit for family life. Costa is equally content doing his own thing or hanging out with the family, whether it’s relaxing on the couch or enjoying a quiet moment outdoors. With his loving nature and laid-back attitude, Costa is sure to bring joy and comfort to your home.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: Rocky is a friendly and easy-going male greyhound who loves socializing with young children and other medium-sized dogs. This laid-back fellow is happy to go with the flow, whether it’s enjoying a quiet moment at home or joining in on family activities. Rocky is a calm and adaptable companion, making him an ideal choice for a family looking for a well-mannered dog who’s great with kids and other pets. His gentle nature and relaxed attitude mean he’s content to simply be part of the family and enjoy whatever life brings his way.

NAME: Tiggy
TEXT: Tiggy is a sweet, patient female greyhound with a striking Tigger-like orange and black brindle coat. This gentle girl is great with young children and other medium-sized dogs, making her a perfect family companion. Tiggy enjoys living indoors and is content to relax, cuddle, and soak up attention. She’s easy-going, low-maintenance, and requires only a few walks and some playtime each day. Tiggy’s calm nature and loving personality make her an ideal addition to a peaceful home, and she would thrive in a family environment where she can receive the affection and care she deserves.

NAME: Jay Jay
TEXT: Say g’day to JayJay this beautiful female has had a wonderful life around children as young as 1 year old and also around Medium dogs. Jayjay is 5 years of age and is a perfect mix between puppy playful during the day and settled mature girl of a night. Jay jay is always excited to go for a walk and would be the perfect dog for someone looking at undertaking adventures and longer walks Jayjay travels well in a car and would love a backyard to play the day away in

NAME: Dave
TEXT: Dave is personality plus & ready to spread joy to all who meet him. He's a goofy boy who is energetic, as well as super sweet and affectionate. He could suit apartment living with someone around all the time - he loves being indoors but still learning to be left alone. Dave requires a quiet/low stimulation home life & someone who can keep him active and mentally fit. Older kids who can handle a goofy large breed dog would suit best. Dave has great food drive and responds well to training. Dave would enjoy a home with canine or human company during the day, and would thrive with living with another bouncy vibrant canine companion.

NAME: Oscar
TEXT: Oscar is a confident and happy dog who is looking for someone to help guide him through life. Oscar loves being active and enjoys a run around during the day whilst you are at work. Oscar will show you his gentler side once he has gotten all his energy out and with the right home could suit cuddling up on a bed of a night time. Oscar would be suited to someone that has a backyard or courtyard and can take him on his daily walk to explore the streets.

NAME: Colin
TEXT: Colin is an outgoing boy who loves to go on adventures and would love a daily walk around the neighbourhood. Colin can be a little bit cautious at the very start but settles very quickly and becomes your best friend within minutes. Colin jumps with excitement but settles very quickly Colin loves a car trip and is happy to jump up in to the car before laying down and sleeping the trip away. Colin would love a single person or a young couple who are keen to spend some time teaching him about the adventures of the world and what a lounge feels like to sleep on Colin is ready to give a family lots of love

NAME: Baby
TEXT: Nobody puts baby in the corner! This little lady is looking to learn all about the world with you! She would suit short hours alone as a solo girl, or longer hours with a canine companion. Polite with dogs big or small, beautiful Baby has so much love to give and is searching for the right place to call home. If this Baby girl sounds like the perfect addition to your family, apply to take her home from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Bear is a wonderfully sweet nature and a calm temperament. Bear's calm demeanor makes him an ideal partner for leisurely strolls, as he's quite responsive on a lead. Whether you're taking a walk in the park or simply exploring your local neighborhood, Bear's company will surely make your day brighter. His gentle pace and attentive nature are perfect for anyone seeking a serene and steady walking buddy.

NAME: Clyde
TEXT: Meet Clyde, the charming socialite of the dog world! This happy-go-lucky greyhound is always ready to make new friends and engage with anyone he meets. His confidence shines as he approaches life with a tail wag and a friendly demeanor that wins over hearts immediately. Clyde absolutely adores ear scratches, and you’ll find him happily leaning in for more attention whenever he gets the chance. Whether he's meeting new people or hanging out with his greyhound buddies, Clyde is always the life of the party, making sure everyone feels welcome and included.

NAME: Ivanka
TEXT: Meet Ivanka, a playful and excited lady with a heart full of affection! This happy female greyhound is ready to bring joy and energy to your home. Playful and affectionate. Loves to give a classic Greyhound lean and cuddle. Social with larger dogs and open to learning to love smaller canine friends. Enjoys active playtime and engaging walks. Thrives in a lively environment where she can express her playful spirit. A loving and active household that can keep up with her playful nature. Suitable for families or individuals who appreciate a happy, energetic companion. If you’re looking for a lively and loving companion, Ivanka would be thrilled to meet you! Reach out for more information or to schedule a visit.

NAME: Moe Joe
TEXT: Meet Joe, an old sweet and gentle boy looking for a quiet, loving home! This charming male greyhound may be a little slow on his feet, but he has a heart full of affection and is ready to bring warmth to your life. Gentle and loving. Loves a gentle touch and affection. Social with larger dogs and open to learning to love smaller canine family members. Prefers leisurely strolls and relaxed outings. Enjoys a calm environment where he can feel safe and cherished. A peaceful household that appreciates a slower pace. Ideal for individuals or families who can provide plenty of love and companionship. If you’re looking for a sweet companion to share your home with, Joe would love to meet you! Reach out for more information or to schedule a visit.

NAME: Issac
TEXT: Meet Issac, an old gentle boy with a heart full of love! This sweet male greyhound is looking for a quiet home where he can enjoy leisurely walks and plenty of cuddles. Gentle and affectionate. Loves a good scratch and is always ready for cuddles. Social with larger dogs and open to learning to love smaller dogs. Prefers leisurely walks at a relaxed pace. Enjoys a calm environment and appreciates quiet time. A peaceful household, perfect for someone who enjoys a slower lifestyle. Ideal for families or individuals who can provide gentle affection and companionship. If you’re looking for a loving companion to share your home with, Issac would be thrilled to meet you! Reach out for more information or to schedule a visit.

NAME: Zooie
TEXT: Meet Zooie, an older gentleman with a heartwarming, sweet nature. This charming male is looking for a peaceful home where he can enjoy gentle affection and quiet moments. Affectionate and loving. Enjoys companionship and thrives on gentle interactions. Prefers gentle walks and leisurely outings. Loves a calm environment and appreciates quiet time at home A quiet household, perfect for someone who enjoys a slower pace. Ideal for individuals or families who can provide plenty of gentle affection and care. If you’re looking for a sweet companion to share your life with, Zooie would be thrilled to meet you! Reach out for more information or to schedule a visit.

NAME: Banjo
TEXT: Meet Banjo, an old friendly boy with a heart of gold! This gentle male greyhound is the perfect companion for anyone looking for a loving pet. Banjo has a warm and welcoming personality, making him great for families and individuals alike. Social and friendly with other larger dogs. Eager to learn and could adapt well to smaller canine family members with time and patience. Enjoys leisurely walks and gentle playtime. Prefers a relaxed lifestyle but still has his playful moments.

NAME: Hunter
TEXT: Meet Hunter, a gentle soul with a heart full of loyalty and companionship to offer. While he may be a tad shy when you first meet him, it doesn't take long for his affectionate personality to shine through. Hunter is an exemplary walker on a lead, showing politeness and attentiveness on each stroll. He won't pull or rush, making daily walks together a serene and enjoyable experience. He thrives in the presence of someone who understands his need for trust-building and who will cherish the meaningful connection he creates with his human family members. While he is happiest in a quiet home environment, Hunter's devotion is unwavering once he gets to know you. With his poised and loyal spirit, Hunter will be by your side as a faithful friend, ready to share life's simple pleasures. If you are looking for a devoted companion who values walks and quiet time alike, Hunter could be your perfect match, offering companionship and loyalty in the most endearing way.

NAME: Brindie
TEXT: This affectionate & playful girl is Brindie! She is on the search for her forever home. If you're after a joyful companion, she is right up there. Brindie is polite and respectful on lead, as she is used to 3 walks a day and lazing around the rest. She is sociable with people & would love to go to her new home that has a nice backyard for her to enjoy. Brindie can be excitable around other dogs and doesn't enjoy when they cramp her personal space too much.

NAME: Foxy
TEXT: Meet our little Foxy girl, a sweet natured girl who would love a family who is happy to take a slower approach while she learns the ropes of being a pet. Foxy is playful, excitable and engaging. She loves to show you her fluffy toys and will happily entertain herself! Foxy is a happy traveler and will be happy to follow you wherever you're off to. She would benefit from leash training, as she can be quite excited going to new places and meeting new people.

NAME: Irena
TEXT: Are you ready to be laughing with your newest furry friend? Well, Irena will have you cackling. She is a true definition of a little pocket rocket, she will be showing all aspects of her zoomies and how confident she is in doing so. Irena enjoys spending her days showing off and basking in the sunshine. She is loves companionship and will happily follow you anywhere you desire. Irena knows her name well and with a little bit of getting used to your voice she will come (running) straight back.

NAME: Diesel
TEXT: Meet Diesel, the easy-going canine companion who will effortlessly win your heart. With his laid-back demeanor and adaptable nature, Diesel is a breeze to have around. Diesel quickly acclimates to new environments, seamlessly settling in and making himself at home. His friendly nature shines when he’s around other medium to large breed dogs, as he loves having similarly sized playmates to romp around with. One of Diesel’s favorite pastimes is swimming. Whether it's plunging into the local lake, exploring tidal rock pools, or playing in the garden sprinkler, he is at his happiest when in the water. Diesel would be happiest in a home where his new family celebrates his relaxed nature and takes time to provide enriching outdoor experiences. He's ready to bring his calm joy to your household!

NAME: Ralph
TEXT: Are you after a little fire-cracker in your life? Look no further than our boy Ralph! He is all things active/fun-loving and absolutely hilarious; Ralph will have your grinning from ear to ear. Ralph would suit an active family with a backyard who can walk him daily and throw his favourite toy around, Ralph hasn't been exposed to an indoor setting as yet so may take some time adjusting but I think he will happily follow you around. His favourite game is showing his friends how quick his zoomies are so a nice backyard will do the trick so he can show off to you. If you're interested in hearing more about Ralph, please apply now.

NAME: Danny
TEXT: Meet Danny, an adorable boy with a heart-melting gaze that makes every day brighter. Danny is a big smootcher who will never oppose to having a big cuddle. Danny is a delight to have around the house, both cleanliness and quietness that will make him a great pet. He has excellent manners and prides himself on being a perfectly well-behaved member of the family. This makes everyday activities a joy, whether it's sharing calming moments at home or embarking on relaxing strolls – as he walks like a gentleman on a lead. Being with Danny means you'll always have a cuddle partner, ready to nestle beside you during quiet evenings or busy afternoons. He is a wonderful nature of warmth, kindness, and intelligence, making him the kind of pet who not only fits seamlessly into your lifestyle but enhances it too.

NAME: Darren
TEXT: Meet Darren, a super laid-back sort of boy, who is happy just to be around his humans, he doesn't ask for much but a pat here and there would strike a bonus. He's happy to explore alone or go for leisurely strolls, you would rarely even hear him bark. Darren enjoys going to school pick up to collect his human- brother who is 12yo and all the kids love to dote on him. If you're interested in knowing more about Darren, please apply now!

NAME: Cilantro
TEXT: Cilantro is a young & sweet boy. His adorable nature & curious enthusiasm makes him a perfect companion for many family types. This bouncy, friendly and wiggly little guy can be curious about the world but his adaptable personality means he'll fit in seamlessly with any loving household. He loves long walkies and playtimes and enjoys having an outlet for his mental stimulation & daily enrichment. He loves treats, toys & loves a little zoomie with a short burst of energy, so would need at least a fully fenced townhouse, or backyard. A few hours alone are no problem with Cilantro as he has shown to cope well in alone time sessions, so if you’re looking for an easy-going & charming boy to complete your family, get in touch with Wester Sydney. Cilantro is available from our Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Bob is a really special boy who is looking for his perfect forever home bob is good with medium to large dogs and is great with children as young as 5 years old Bob takes a little time adjusting to a new lifestyle but once he is settled he is a big goofball who loves company. Bob prefers company but is fine being left alone for long periods of time if he has a few toys and a bone to pass the time. Bob is active at first on lead but settles very quickly and walks perfectly. once Bobs energy is out for the day you’ll find him living the life in the sun

NAME: Wilma
TEXT: **Wilma is in a foster home with a greyhound and a cavoodle** Wilma is such a special girl that one of our GAP staff has taken her home for a sleep over! This quiet natured girl is showing amazing resilience and requires a quiet home to thrive in. She is incredibly dog social and would love a play mate. She however, is happy to relax while you're gone, with or without a dog friend to keep her company. Whether you have another dog or looking for a dog to have play dates with, Wilma will be by your side. She is a shy girl who finds that dogs give her more confidence. A home without children is best suited to her while she learns about the world. Her love of treats and toys is her motivator for learning new tricks and building confidence! She is an affectionate and goofy girl once you get to know her Wilma is available from our Western Sydney adoption centre. **Wilma is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Bruce
TEXT: Meet our big boy Bruce! He is a true delight to be around. He will make you laugh until you cackle. He will be happy to cruise around with you day in and out. He is a gorgeous character to boasts confidence. Bruce suffered a racing injury and required surgery on his front right leg so an experienced owner who knows when to slow down on the zoomies is ideal.

NAME: Chum
TEXT: Meet Chum, the epitome of easy-going and affection! This boy has a sweet personality that instantly wins over hearts. Chum is as laid back as they come. He loves nothing more than being close to his human friends. He's a responsive walker on leash, making strolls in the park or through the neighbourhood a pleasant experience for everyone involved. He naturally exudes confidence, thriving in a variety of social environments, especially around younger children. Chum is not just a pet; he's a loving family member, always eager to make new friends and share in the joys of everyday life. With his friendly disposition and ability to seamlessly fit into any family dynamic, Chum is ready to bring his special warmth and companionship to his new home.

NAME: Moses
TEXT: Are you after a dog to be totally besotted by you? Well meet Moses, a quirky and loveable boy whose after his forever home. Moses boasts confidence and is extremely gentle in his approach. He has been around children 4+ and will request frequent pats. He has been brought up with a jack russel at home, but would benefit from a meet and greet prior to being adopted. Moses will be attending our Adoption Day at Glandore Wines on the 5th of October.

NAME: Alfie
TEXT: Meet Alfie, a delightful and active male greyhound with a zest for life that is absolutely infectious! Alfie is especially great in the company of other medium to large dogs, making him a perfect fit for a home already blessed with canine companions. He's particularly fond of his fellow greyhounds, often seen sharing playful moments and lounging together. His natural sociability extends to a broad range of activities. . He is an ideal candidate for someone with an active lifestyle who enjoys spending time outdoors and interacting with their pets. Alfie is looking for a loving and dynamic home where he can flourish and be an integral part of the family. If you're seeking a loyal, active, and sociable companion to join your family, Alfie might just be the perfect match.

NAME: Stumpy
TEXT: This sociable fellow is a joy to be around and has a knack for bringing smiles to everyone he meets. Stumpy is a social butterfly, especially when it comes to other greyhounds. He thrives in the company of his fellow canines and enjoys the camaraderie of a playful group. If you have other greyhounds or are involved in a greyhound community, Stumpy will fit in seamlessly and form bonds quickly. This gentle dog is well-socialized with children aged nine years and up, making him a wonderful family pet. Whether it's a leisurely stroll in the park or lounging around at home, Stumpy is adaptable and easygoing. Stumpy is not just a pet; he's a loving and loyal friend ready to enrich your life with joy and companionship.

NAME: Willow
TEXT: Willow excels in a social environment and is used to living harmoniously with other greyhounds, making her an excellent addition to a multi-pet household. Willow is house trained, which means she's all set to fit seamlessly into your home without any fuss. Her inquisitive nature makes her a joy to have around, as she's always eager to explore her surroundings. Walking is one of Willow's favorite activities. She has a graceful stride and a calm demeanor that make her the perfect walking buddy. Willow's friendly disposition makes her great for families or individuals looking to add a companion who’s both loving and easygoing. She gets along wonderfully with other greyhounds and would thrive in a household where she can share her days with canine siblings. If you're looking for a loving, house-trained, and curious companion who enjoys the simple pleasures of life, Willow is your girl. She’s ready to become a beloved member of your family, filling your home with warmth, joy, and countless tail wags.

NAME: Lazlo
TEXT: Meet Lazlo, the friendly and easy-going canine companion you've been waiting for. Lazlo's calm demeanor makes him the perfect addition to any household looking for a laid-back yet affectionate furry friend. Lazlo absolutely loves his daily walks and will eagerly await the moment you grab his leash. His love for walking not only provides you both with exercise but offers a great bonding experience. Beyond his love for walks, Lazlo enjoys lounging by your side—content to bask in peaceful moments. His friendly personality ensures he gets along well with everyone he meets, making him a delightful companion for families, singles, or seniors alike. If you're seeking a calm and loving dog who thrives on walks and the company other dogs.

NAME: Johnie
TEXT: Meet Johnie, a confident and friendly canine who is sure to brighten your days with his playful nature and infectious energy. Johnie loves to play and is always up for a game of fetch. His exuberance is paired with a love for swimming, making him the perfect partner for summer adventures by the pool, lake, or beach. Despite his playful demeanor, Johnie also showcases an endearing blend of confidence and friendliness. He has no trouble making new friends, whether they are human or fellow canines. Being playful Johnie likes to get to know his new friends prior to a play date. His confident disposition ensures that he approaches new experiences with curiosity and excitement, making every day an adventure.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: Rocky is a sweet boy with experience around kids 12+ and has spent lots of time around other greyhounds, making him a lovely addition to your home if you already have a hound! Rocky is a sweet hound who would enjoy further training in the home to be the best pet he can be. He can be nervous around new people but has proven to be a total sweetie pie once you get to know him! Rocky is available from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Spot is independent and enjoys spending time roaming around. Spot would suit a family who is after a companion to cruise around the backyard with. At times Spot can be weary and a bit timid in new environments but with the right re-assurance, she recovers really well. If you're interested in meeting our darling Spot, please apply now.

NAME: Riot
TEXT: Meet Riot, the epitome of easygoing! With a name that speaks to his spirit, Riot is ready to fill your days with joy and companionship. His gentle nature and playful antics make him an ideal addition to any home looking for a devoted friend. Riot has an amazing disposition that makes him friendly to people and pets alike. He'll fit into almost any living situation that keeps him active and allows him time for fun and an outdoor activities. With a healed fractured hock, it's crucial Riot's new family appreciates the care required to ensure he stays in tip-top shape. Ideally suited for someone who has experience with greyhounds, Riot will thrive in the care of an owner who understands how to bring out the best in him.

NAME: Felix
TEXT: Felix is the card you've been hoping to draw! This interesting lad is definitely personality plus, if not a little odd - in an endearing and adorable way of course! ✅ Absolutely loves people! Both the giving and receiving attention side of it! ✅ Travels very well in the car - so no excuse, he can attend your road trips! ✅ Such a community hero, Felix is a blood donor. ✅ Clever Felix comes to his name - we're not going to lie, he won't come if he doesn't feel like it. But he does know you're calling him 😎 ✅ At only 28.5kg, Felix is quite small for a male greyhound ✅ Felix has been spending time inside his current home - and loving the luxuries of pet life! ✅ Felix is crate trained and could live in an apartment (you'll be pleased to know he is very clean in his crate!) ✅ Loves his toys! So can be easily entertained with some toys he can call his own. ✅ Felix loves the water so get ready for some pool time, beach time, pond time - whatever water time you can offer him! ✅ Felix is happy to either be the only fur baby in your life, or could live with a female dog (he is a bit funny with other males...) - He would still need very slow, gradual introductions to any new dogs. ✅ Felix is good with children. He can get a bit excited so would be suited to kids 10+ years at this stage. If you would like to bask in the comic genius that is funny Felix, enquire or apply to adopt this little fella below!

NAME: Jackson
TEXT: Jackson is a sweet boy with a lot of love to give! He is polite with big and small dogs and would enjoy further socialisation and getting to know other dogs and people! He would enjoy a home with another calm M-L canine companion. We think Jackson would enjoy a quiet neighbourhood to enjoy the serenity, and older respectful children who can give him space when he needs some peace and quiet. We know Jackson will make a wonderful pet! Jackson is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Sriracha
TEXT: This quiet natured boy is friendly with other greyhounds and would enjoy a home who will enjoy building his confidence. A quiet, adults only home or a home with respectful children would suit Sriracha as he learns how to be a pet. He is super smart and enjoying engaging in training activities. He has already learnt "down" and "touch" on cue! A backyard and quiet neighbourhood will help him settle in, and as a lover of food, enrichment and puzzle toys will go far in helping him settle in. A few hours alone are no problem as he snoozes the day away. He is such a friendly boy once he's warmed up and would benefit from a slow exposure to the big wide world. He loves a cuddle with his handler - see picturtes! Sriracha is available from the Western Sydney adoption facility.

NAME: Frankie
TEXT: Frankie is a cheeky happy girl with little bursts of energy, who gets along with greyhounds and even showing to be polite with little doggies too. This happy lady would suit a quiet environment so she can grow in confidence becoming your beloved pet. Respectful/quiet children would enjoy her quiet nature, with a slow introduction to new people and new environments. Another doggie friend will give Frankie a confidence boost. Frankie is available from GAP's Western Sydney adoption centre via appointment.

NAME: Moi Moi
TEXT: Meet Moi Moi, a delightful canine who prances through life with an infectious smile. Raised alongside children from the age of five and up. Moi's easygoing nature and affectionate heart make him an ideal companion for families of all shapes and sizes. Moi Moi's endearing "antenna ears" are more than just a charming feature; they make him ever-alert to your presence. Moi Moi's sociable demeanor extends to other animals too. He has met small dogs and remained remarkably unfazed, suggesting he's adaptable and friendly when it comes to making new furry friends. Adopt Moi Moi, and you'll invite endless joy and happiness into your life with this lovable, ear-wagging, prancing pup.

NAME: Axel
TEXT: Let me introduce Axel! Axel is a gentle and loving soul with a beautifully soft nature. He is friendly and sociable with all dogs when introduced and supervised properly. Axel will adapt well to full-time workers and is comfortable with children. Axel would thrive in a home with access to a yard. Axel would love to find a caring environment where he can enjoy affection, have outdoor space, and interact positively with other dogs and children.

NAME: Sky
TEXT: This is Sky! Sky is a bit shy initially but warms up quickly with a gentle touch. She is very gentle with young children and enjoy snuggling and being patted. Her ideal home would be a home without other dogs or with larger dogs. Sky will adapt to a household with full-time workers, provided she has access to a yard.

NAME: Milkshake
TEXT: Young, laid back, loving, friendly and very handsome, Milkshake is made of all the right ingredients to fit your life. Milkshake is a quiet natured boy who would suit a nurturing home with a gentle touch. He is gentle on the lead, and we would love to see his confidence build in a home. Shy by nature and still young, he is bravely learning the ropes here. Another medium to large canine companion could help support his confidence in a home. Respectful children on the quiet/gentle side would suit him the best. Milkshake is going to grow up to make an amazing addition to your life. Milkshake is available from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Julian
TEXT: Julian is best described as a distinguished gentleman. He is calm, friendly and an easy-going boy who just goes about his day without a fuss. He's walked around busy streets, schools, shopping centres as well as farms and paddocks. Nothing much fazes Julian, including other large dogs, small dogs and children. He loves people and pats and loves a walk, rarely pulling. Julian would suit most households and make a very special and loving companion who wants to be with you.

NAME: Tonto
TEXT: Tonto is a vibrant and friendly Greyhound with a personality that’s as dynamic as it is affectionate. His playful nature and sociable demeanor make him an ideal companion for an active and engaging home. Tonto is full of energy and loves to have fun. His playful attitude makes him a hit with people and other pets alike. He’s always up for a game and enjoys being the center of attention in social settings. With his outgoing and friendly nature, Tonto quickly makes friends wherever he goes. He’s approachable and eager to interact, making him a great addition to any family or social gathering. Tonto has a zest for life and particularly enjoys running. Whether it’s a sprint in the park or a game of fetch, he thrives on physical activity and loves to stretch his legs. Given his energetic and sociable nature, Tonto is best suited for an active home where he can get plenty of exercise and engagement. He’ll thrive in an environment where he can be part of family activities and enjoy regular playtime. If you’re looking for a Greyhound who is playful, social, and loves to run, Tonto could be the perfect fit for you. His enthusiastic personality and love for activity will bring energy and joy to your home.

NAME: Emmie
TEXT: Emmie is a lovely Greyhound with a heart full of affection and a playful spirit. Her endearing personality and love for canine companionship make her a delightful addition to any home. Emmie is a charming girl with a naturally sweet disposition. Her gentle and loving nature makes her a joy to be around. Emmie adores human company and thrives on affection. She’s always eager to share her love and will happily snuggle up for some quality bonding time. With a zest for life, Emmie enjoys playful activities and fun interactions. Whether it's a game of fetch, running around in the yard, or engaging in lively play, she brings energy and enthusiasm to every moment. Emmie has a great fondness for other dogs and enjoys their company. She’s friendly and sociable with canine companions, making her a great fit for a home with other dogs. If you’re looking for a Greyhound who is sweet, affectionate, and full of playful energy, Emmie could be the perfect match. Her love for people and canine friends alike ensures she’ll bring warmth and joy to your home.

NAME: Shay
TEXT: Shay is a distinguished male Greyhound with a kind heart and an adventurous spirit.
